admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Master-Studiengang Robotik/ Robotics an der Technischen Hochschule Deggendorf (§ 2 Qualifikationsvoraussetzungen, § 5, § 8 Eignungsprüfung)
admission_regulation.version: SPO vom 23. Juli 2025 (published by notice 24.07.2025), in force 1 October (2025), for students starting from WS 2025/26 (§ 13). Previous SPO vom 19. Februar 2025 (for students from SS 2025; same admission rules as far as visible). The university-law page lists no Änderungssatzung for this programme (checked 2026-10-17; re-checked for batch 10 on 2026-10-17: the page still lists only the SS 2025 and WS 2025/26 SPOs, no amendment). Language proof refers to § 3 of the Rahmenprüfungsordnung für die Zusatzausbildung im Bereich der Fremdsprachen und Allgemeinwissenschaftlichen Wahlpflichtfächer vom 01.10.2018 (not opened).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 1: a first degree 'im Umfang von mindestens 210 ECTS-Punkten aus dem Bereich' Robotik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieur, Produktionsingenieur, Regelungstechnik, Informatik, Elektronik, Bioinformatik, Gesundheitsinformatik, Automatisierungstechnik or a related/equivalent degree; 'Über die Gleichwertigkeit der Abschlüsse entscheidet die Prüfungskommission.' Plus a passed aptitude test (§ 8) unless waived. Programme page: 'at least 210 ECTS credits in robotics or a closely related engineering discipline'. SPO § 2 Abs. 1 names Elektrotechnik and Elektronik explicitly. This electrical_electronic_engineering record is one field copy of a multi-field programme (9838_cs rebuilt in batch 9 from the same evidence; a mechanical copy exists in another field file). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No grade limit for access. SPO § 8 Abs. 2: the Prüfungskommission 'kann' waive the aptitude test for above-average qualifications: 'Als überdurchschnittlich gelten Abschlüsse mit der Note „gut” (<2,5) und besser' or grade 2,5 and better in Mathematik, Regelungstechnik, Physik, Informatik and Mechatronik or Robotik (or related subjects). No conversion method stated.

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject credit requirements in the SPO. Subject knowledge is checked by the aptitude test (§ 8): 90-minute written or online exam on higher mathematics for engineers and fundamentals of robotics, computer science and programming, mechatronics, control engineering and electrical engineering.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen for missing subject competences. SPO § 5 only covers degrees with at least 180 but fewer than 210 ECTS: the missing ECTS (max. 30) must be proven by the start of the third semester (internship of at least 20 weeks or relevant undergraduate courses of the university) as a condition for passing the Masterprüfung — a total-credit rule, not a subject condition (lesson 8).

descriptive_notes: Aptitude test (SPO § 8) unless waived: written or online exam of 90 minutes on higher mathematics for engineers and fundamentals of robotics, computer science/programming, mechatronics, control engineering and electrical engineering; graded by two professors who must agree; passed 'mit Erfolg abgelegt'; held every semester; one retake at the next half-year date.

Waiver possible (Prüfungskommission 'kann'): degree grade 'gut' (<2,5) or better, or grade 2,5 or better in Mathematik, Regelungstechnik, Physik, Informatik and Mechatronik or Robotik (SPO § 8 Abs. 2).
Specialisation (Intelligent Robotics or Assistive Robotics) must be chosen in the application; no entitlement that a specialisation runs (SPO § 4).

language_english.note: SPO § 2 Abs. 2: 'Englische Sprachkenntnisse auf dem Sprachniveau B2 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen'; proof under § 3 of the Rahmenprüfungsordnung (not opened). THD language-requirements PDF: Robotics B2; only TOEFL iBT accepted; IELTS General and Academic accepted (not IELTS Indicator); certificates not older than 2 years; the score table could not be attributed reliably to tests, so no minimum scores are stored. MyGermanUniversity (checked 24.10.2026): B2 — IELTS 5.5 overall (5.5 in each section), TOEFL iBT 72.

other_requirements: Bachelor's with 180-209 ECTS: missing ECTS (max. 30) by the start of the 3rd semester via a 20-week relevant internship or undergraduate courses after advising (SPO § 5)
choice of specialisation (Intelligent Robotics or Assistive Robotics) in the application (SPO § 4)
German A2 to be proven by the end of studies (SPO § 2 Abs. 2; THD language-requirements PDF)
GATE or GRE scores encouraged but not mandatory for degrees from non-signatory states of the Lisbon Recognition Convention; Home Editions not accepted (programme page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 June (application period 15 April - 15 June; programme page, no separate international deadline listed)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 December (application period 15 October - 1 December; programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Fachprüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Advanced Engineering and Engineering Management an der Fachhochschule Südwestfalen, Standort Soest, vom 15. November 2023 (§ 3), with the Rahmenprüfungsordnung (RPO) of the Fachhochschule Südwestfalen
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachungen der FH Südwestfalen Nr. 1255 vom 15.11.2023, in force the day after publication, first applies to students in their first semester in WS 2024/25 (§ 23). Amendments: 'Ordnung zur Änderung der Fachprüfungsordnung … vom 05. März 2026' (Amtliche Bekanntmachungen Nr. 1422 vom 17.03.2026, in force the day after publication) — scanned PDF, read 17.10.2026 from Koushik's screenshots: Art. I Nr. 1 gives § 3 a completely new wording (fields below follow it); also changes §§ 6, 11, 20 (not admission-relevant).

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO § 3 Abs. 1 (new wording 05.03.2026): 'erfolgreichen Abschluss ... in einem mindestens siebensemestrigen Bachelorstudiengang oder einem Diplomstudiengang im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren einschlägigen Studiengang mit überwiegenden Inhalten der Ingenieurwissenschaften, der Informatik oder des Software Engineerings'. The former six-semester route with 30-ECTS Ergänzungsqualifizierung (old § 3 Abs. 1 b) is no longer in the text. The Prüfungsausschuss decides relevance. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (a mechanical copy exists in another field file).

grade_requirement.note: FPO § 3 Abs. 1 (2026): 'mit mindestens der Gesamtnote „Gut“ (2,5) oder mit einer Einstufung gemäß ECTS-Einstufungstabelle innerhalb der besten 35 Prozent der Absolventinnen und Absolventen eines mindestens zweijährigen Abschlusszeitraums'. The best-35-% alternative cannot be checked by the engine (DECISION). No conversion method for foreign grades stated.

items.raw_label: FPO § 3 Abs. 1 (2026): 'Außerdem müssen in diesem Studiengang mindestens 10 ECTS-Credits in informatiknahen Modulen erbracht worden sein.'

subject_credit_requirements.note: NEW requirement from the 2026 amendment (not in the 2023 FPO). 'informatiknahe Module' stored as general_cs + programming pool (POOLED). The Prüfungsausschuss decides on '10 ECTS-Credits in informatiknahen Modulen'. Koushik rule 20.10.2026: general_cs counts ALL CS subjects, so CS sub-categories under a general_cs main item are removed (redundant).

conditional_admission.mechanism: New § 3 (2026) contains no Auflagen/make-up rule; the old six-semester Ergänzungsqualifizierung was removed with the new wording.

descriptive_notes: Grade alternative: instead of 'Gut' (2,5), a ranking within the best 35 % of graduates (ECTS grading table, at least a two-year cohort) also qualifies (FPO § 3 Abs. 1).

allowed_exemptions: Bachelor's taught exclusively in English at a university in Germany (FPO § 3)
(Fach)hochschulreife from Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States (FPO § 3)
language_english.note: FPO § 3 Abs. 2 (2026): TOEFL 575 paper / 232 computer / 90 iBT for results obtained until 20.01.2026; for results from 21.01.2026: 575 / 232 / 'mit einem Ergebnis von mindestens 4.5, wobei die Teildisziplin Schreiben ebenfalls mit 4.5 bewertet sein muss' (new TOEFL 1–6 scale; GPU-R stores iBT 90 for old-scale results). IELTS 'mindestens 6.5, wobei die Teildisziplin Schreiben mit mindestens 6.5 bewertet sein muss'. § 3 Abs. 3: if no certificate, a combined oral/written English exam on application (max. two attempts).

aps_certificate.note: Programme page: 'New: Applicants from India have to provide APS (Academic Evaluation Center)'.

other_requirements: Non-EU applicants apply via uni-assist (programme page)
Minimum 7-semester bachelor (stored as 210 ECTS, GPU-R arithmetic) — FPO § 3 Abs. 1 (2026)
IELTS writing ≥ 6.5; TOEFL (from 21.01.2026) overall and writing ≥ 4.5

non_eu_deadlines.summer: mid-May to 15 November (programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Fachprüfungsordnung (FPO-M) für das Fach Mechatronics (MECH) im Masterstudium an der Universität Siegen vom 28. September 2023 (§ 4), with the Rahmenprüfungsordnung (RPO-M) für das Masterstudium an der Universität Siegen vom 28. Februar 2019
admission_regulation.version: FPO-M: Amtliche Mitteilungen Nr. 72/2023 of 29.09.2023, in force the day after publication; amended by Ordnung zur Änderung der FPO-M vom 19. September 2024 (AM 58/2024), which only adds module 4ETMA167 to Anlage 4 (no admission change). Searched 17.10.2026 for 2025-2026 amendments (Siegen Amtliche Mitteilungen 'Änderung Fachprüfungsordnung Mechatronics'): none found; the English translation (26.07.2024 file) also names only AM 72/2023 + 58/2024. RPO-M: nichtamtliche Lesefassung incl. Vierte Änderungsordnung vom 12. Juni 2025 (AM 41/2025).

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 1: 'Ergänzend zu § 4 RPO-M ist Voraussetzung für den Zugang zum Masterstudium Mechatronics' a first professional university degree in 'einer ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Disziplin mit Bezügen zur Elektrotechnik oder zum Maschinenbau' or in a 'vergleichbaren Bachelorstudiengang'. § 4 Abs. 2 ties the LP table to the comparable route ('Der vergleichbare Bachelorstudiengang im Sinne von Absatz 1 muss Kompetenzen in den folgenden Bereichen ...'). No separate LP tables per prior field: the only field-specific part of admission is the OR line 'Grundlagen der Elektro- und Messtechnik oder Grundlagen in der Mechanik'; prior field (Elektrotechnik vs Maschinenbau) decides the compulsory Angleichungsblock in the programme (§ 8 Abs. 3-5), not access. Programme page: 'a first professionally qualifying degree in an engineering subject'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record (a mechanical copy exists in another field file), not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 3: 'Es handelt sich um einen qualifizierten Abschluss, wenn der Bachelorabschluss mindestens mit der Note „2,7“' abgeschlossen wurde (qualifizierter Abschluss per § 4 Abs. 2 RPO-M). No conversion method for foreign grades stated in the FPO-M.

items.raw_label: § 4 Abs. 2 Mathematische Grundlagen 20 LP
§ 4 Abs. 2 Naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen 15 LP
§ 4 Abs. 2 Grundlagen der Elektro- und Messtechnik oder Grundlagen in der Mechanik 10 LP

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 2 table (minimum scope): Mathematische Grundlagen 20 LP, Naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen 15 LP, Grundlagen der Elektro- und Messtechnik oder Grundlagen in der Mechanik 10 LP, Projektarbeit (einschließlich Bachelorarbeit) 10 LP. The table is worded for the 'vergleichbare Bachelorstudiengang' route; GPU-R applies it to all applicants (strictest reading, GPU-R policy, not regulation wording; see DECISION in notes). 'Naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen' is stored as physics + chemistry pool; chemistry, technical mechanics and project/thesis have no eee category (TAXONOMY GAP, count 0 until the taxonomy phase — strict). Koushik rule 19.10.2026 (applies to ALL records): thesis / scientific-work credit items are removed — every bachelor graduate has sufficient thesis or project work. Removed item: § 4 Abs. 2 Projektarbeit (einschließlich Bachelorarbeit) 10 LP Koushik decision 20.10.2026 (general_ee now counts ALL EE subjects, so it is no longer used for basics): 'Grundlagen der Elektro- und Messtechnik oder Grundlagen in der Mechanik 10 LP' = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory (EE basics) + measurement_instrumentation (Messtechnik) + mechanics_dynamics (Mechanik alternative), add-up rule.

conditional_admission.mechanism: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 5: 'Eine Zulassung unter Auflagen gemäß § 4 Absatz 4 RPO-M ist möglich; hierüber entscheidet im Einzelfall der Prüfungsausschuss Mechatronics.' RPO-M § 4 Abs. 4: 'Auflagen können nur im Umfang von maximal 30 Leistungspunkten erteilt werden.'; they should be completed in the first two semesters and must be proven at the latest at registration of the Masterarbeit.

descriptive_notes: Access is refused if the applicant has definitively failed a required examination in a closely related programme (FPO-M § 4 Abs. 6).
Department application page (marked as no longer updated): main criteria are the final Bachelor grade and language skills; 'we have to apply an admission limit'; 'there will be no interview.'

Compulsory Angleichungsblock in the programme by prior field: Elektrotechnik graduates take 4MECHMA001/002 (6 LP each), Maschinenbau graduates 4MECHMA011/012 (6 LP each); unclear cases decided by the Prüfungsausschuss (FPO-M § 8 Abs. 3-5).

allowed_exemptions: native speakers from USA, Canada, Great Britain, New Zealand and Australia (programme pages)
language_english.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 4: 'der Nachweis englischer Sprachkenntnisse mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 gemäß des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens' or TOEFL iBT at least 88 or IELTS 6.0; no exemptions in the FPO-M. Department application page: 'TOEFL iBT = min. 88 or IELTS (academic) = minimum 6.0 or Cambridge First = minimum 175 or PTE Academic = minimum 61'; 'Score cards NOT older than 2 years'; 'Medium of instruction letter (MOI) is not acceptable!' PTE 61 and Cambridge First 175 are from the programme pages only.

other_requirements: online application via the University of Siegen portal (unisono) with digital scans of transcript of records and certificates (department application page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 January - 30 April (programme page; no separate non-EU deadline listed)

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung zur Erlangung des akademischen Grades MASTER für den englischsprachigen Studiengang ELEKTRO- UND INFORMATIONSTECHNIK (MET) [ELECTRICAL AND COMPUTER ENGINEERING], Studiengangsspezifische Bestimmungen (§ 1), with the Allgemeine Bestimmungen for Master's study at Hochschule Anhalt and the Satzung zur Durchführung des Feststellungsverfahrens für Studiengänge mit besonderen Eignungsvoraussetzungen (FSV-Satzung)
admission_regulation.version: Fachbereichsrat 26.07.2023, signed 30.01.2024; Amtliches Mitteilungsblatt der Hochschule Anhalt Nr. 94/2024 (Redaktionsschluss 28.03.2024), in force the day after publication, for students enrolled from 01.10.2024 (§ 8). Double-degree supplements (1. and 2. Satzung, 20.12.2023, AM 94/2024) concern only the double-degree options. No amendment found (programme page lists only these three documents). Allgemeine Bestimmungen and FSV-Satzung (which hold any grade limit and the selection criteria) NOT READ — BLOCKED. German SPO MET vom 26.07.2023 (AM 94) § 1 re-read 17.10.2026 (text supplied by Koushik): degree in EIT, Biomedizinische Technik, Medientechnik or comparable + 'berufspraktische Erfahrung von in der Regel nicht weniger als einem Jahr'; admission 'durch ein Feststellungsverfahren auf Basis der ... Satzung zur Durchführung des Feststellungsverfahrens' (FSV-Satzung 23.02.2022, AM 89/2022 Teil II p. 193 — NOT YET READ, holds the grade); § 1 Abs. 2 Anpassungsmodule up to 30 ECTS; § 1 Abs. 3 English B2. FSV-Satzung vom 23.02.2022 'ab dem Studienjahr 2022/2023' (AM 89/2022 Teil II pp. 193–208; text supplied by Koushik 17.10.2026). § 3 Abs. 2–3: the first-degree grade has the majority weight; Fachbereichsräte may set minimum grades. Caveat: annexes are titled 'Feststellungsverfahren zum Studienjahr 2022/23'; no later FSV version found in the AM index (issues 90–98 not opened individually).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 1 Abs. 1: 'Zulassungsvoraussetzung ist ein qualifizierter Hochschulabschluss in den Bachelorstudiengängen Elektro- und Informationstechnik, Biomedizinische Technik, Medientechnik oder vergleichbarer Studiengänge und eine darauf aufbauende berufspraktische Erfahrung von in der Regel nicht weniger als einem Jahr.' 'Die Zulassung erfolgt durch ein Feststellungsverfahren auf Basis der jeweils geltenden Satzung zur Durchführung des Feststellungsverfahrens für Studiengänge mit besonderen Eignungsvoraussetzungen.' primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: FSV-Satzung Anlage 14 (MET): '1. Mindestnote Zeugnis von bis 2,7 □ geht in das Feststellungsverfahren / > 2,7 □ erfüllt die Mindestanforderungen nicht - keine Zulassung möglich'. Grade ≤ 2,7 only admits to the selection procedure (motivation letter, relevance of first degree, English level, possibly interview).

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject credit requirements in the SPO. For applicants with fewer than 210 ECTS / under 3 1/2 years or a 'comparable' degree, the Studienfachberater checks whether the Bachelor competences suffice (§ 1 Abs. 2).

conditional_admission.mechanism: SPO § 1 Abs. 2: for applicants with fewer than 210 ECTS or under 3 1/2 years, or with a degree listed as comparable, the Studienfachberater checks the competences; 'Zum Erwerb eventuell fehlender Kompetenzen vereinbart der Studienfachberater schriftlich und individuell in Absprache mit den Bewerbern aus dem Katalog der Anpassungsmodule in Anlage 1e Module im Umfang von bis zu 30 ECTS'. Results are listed separately and not in the Masterzeugnis; thesis registration requires at most 10 ECTS of Anpassungsmodule outstanding (§ 7 Abs. 1).

descriptive_notes: Admission is decided through a Feststellungsverfahren under the 'Satzung zur Durchführung des Feststellungsverfahrens für Studiengänge mit besonderen Eignungsvoraussetzungen' (SPO § 1 Abs. 1); criteria not read (FSV-Satzung blocked).

allowed_exemptions: German Hochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife / Fachhochschulreife with English as a foreign language, case by case (SPO § 1 Abs. 3)
language_english.note: SPO § 1 Abs. 3: applicants 'müssen nachweisen, dass sie Englisch auf Niveaustufe B2 im Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmen beherrschen'; a German entrance qualification 'wird als Nachweis der Sprachkenntnisse anerkannt, wenn Englisch als Fremdsprache belegt wurde.' No test scores found in the sources read. FSV-Satzung Anlage 14 (MET): 'TOEFL mit ibT mind. 90 Punkten, IELTS mit mind. 6,5 oder Vergleichbare' — regulation values stored (programme page differs).

other_requirements: professional experience after the first degree of 'in der Regel nicht weniger als einem Jahr' (SPO § 1 Abs. 1)
application via uni-assist (international) or SSC portal (national) (programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Zugangs- und Zulassungsordnung für die konsekutiven Masterstudiengänge der Hochschule Bremen vom 10. Dezember 2013 (§ 2 and Anlage, row 'Electronics Engineering M. Sc.')
admission_regulation.version: Official Lesefassung 'umfasst die Änderungen einschließlich der Beschlussfassung des Akademischen Senats vom 30.06.2026' (Amtliche Mitteilungen der Hochschule Bremen 4/2013 sowie zuletzt 5/2026); only the Amtliche Mitteilungen are binding. Compared with the previous Lesefassung (Senate 27.05.2025, AM 6/2025): same § 2 rules and same EE Anlage values (grade 'gut' 2,5; Englisch C1; deutsche Sprachkenntnisse 'werden nicht vorausgesetzt'); the 4-semester variant's footnote 'Vorbehaltlich der Genehmigung' (2025) is no longer marked in the 2026 extract. AM 5/2026 and AM 6/2025 issues themselves not opened (changes taken from the Lesefassungen).

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZugZulO § 2 Abs. 1: first professional degree '(Bachelor oder Diplom einer Universität, Fachhochschule, vergleichbaren ausländischen Hochschule oder einer akkreditierten Berufsakademie)'. § 2 Abs. 2: 'Der Abschluss nach Absatz 1 muss in einschlägigen, für das Masterstudium relevanten Fachgebieten erworben worden sein. Die Fachgebiete des vorangegangenen Studiums sind dann einschlägig und für das Masterstudium relevant, wenn sie die wesentlichen Inhalte der Fachgebiete des entsprechenden grundständigen Bachelorstudiengangs der Hochschule Bremen überwiegend abdecken.' Anlage EE row: 'Ergänzungen zur Einschlägigkeit des Erststudiums, Abs. 2': '-'. Programme page (msc-ee.hs-bremen.de): 'Bachelor's, German "Diplom" or an equivalent first academic degree in a discipline relevant to the course profile applied for'. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: ZugZulO § 2 Abs. 1: 'mindestens mit der Durchschnittsnote „gut“ (2,5) oder einem ECTS-Grade A bis B bewerteten ersten berufsqualifizierenden Abschluss'; foreign degrees by 'im Vergleich des jeweils landesüblichen Notensystems äquivalenten Leistungen' (no conversion formula stated). § 2 Abs. 5: in 'begründeten Ausnahmefällen' applicants with 2,6 to 3,0 ('befriedigend') may be included 'nach Maßgabe der Anlage zu dieser Ordnung' and then take part with 2,5 - the EE Anlage row states no such Maßgabe (see DECISION in notes). Programme page (msc-ee.hs-bremen.de/internet/requirements, older page): international applicants 'a CGPA of at least 3.00 / 4.00 or 7.50 / 10.00' or 'First class with distinction or with percentage larger 70%'.

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anlage EE row: 'Fachinhalte Erststudium, Abs. 3 Nr. 1': '-' (no subject areas or credit numbers). Relevance of the degree (§ 2 Abs. 2) is assessed against the HSB bachelor; no items stored (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No programme-level make-up rule for subject gaps. ZugZulO § 6 Abs. 3 ('Die Zulassung ... erfolgt unter der Auflage, dass der zusätzliche Kompetenzerwerb innerhalb der vereinbarten Frist erfolgt') belongs to the § 6 rule for first degrees below the usual total credits (total-credit rule, not a subject condition; Lesson 8). § 3 Abs. 5: admission 'unter dem Vorbehalt' when the degree certificate is still missing.

descriptive_notes: Admission is restricted: ranking by points (§ 4); Anlage EE weights: 'Durchschnittsnote Erststudium' 60 %, 'Einschlägigkeit Erststudium' 30 %, and 10 % for a third criterion (2026 extract: 'Bewertung Auswahlgespräch'; 2025 extract: 'berufspraktische Tätigkeit' - table extraction ambiguous). 'Bei Ranggleichheit entscheidet das Los.'
Grade exception (§ 2 Abs. 5): applicants with 2,6-3,0 may be included in justified exceptional cases 'nach Maßgabe der Anlage' and then compete with 2,5.
Programme page: 'Decision is made by the admission board of the programme'; 'For international applicants we have a pre-selection process to make sure you have time for visa application.'

allowed_exemptions: English as the main language of instruction during studies (university confirmation)
language_english.note: Anlage EE row 'Fremdsprachenkenntnisse, Abs. 3 Nr. 2': 'Englisch C1'. Programme page (msc-ee.hs-bremen.de/internet/language): TOEFL '550 paper based / 213 computer based / 79 internet based', IELTS 'Level 7.0', European students 'C1 Level'; exempt if English was the main language of instruction. The page's TOEFL 79 is not stated as C1 by the regulation (difference noted).

other_requirements: two references from persons in education or industry (programme page)
3-semester variant needs 210 ECTS (winter or summer start); 4-semester variant needs 180 ECTS (summer start only, deadline 15 October) - ZugZulO § 2 Abs. 1 and Anlage
German: regulation 'werden nicht vorausgesetzt'; programme page asks for basic German, preferably A2, before arrival, and expects enrolment in both German language modules

admission_regulation.version: Lesefassung read 17.10.2026 from the PDF supplied by Koushik (downloaded from the official hs-bremerhaven.de link; the fetch tool could not open the URL). Applies since the SS 2019 procedure (§ 6). Amendments included per header: 11/2018, 1/2021, 5/2025.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Programme page: 'Completion of a bachelor's degree in an engineering study program with 210 credit points (ECTS)'. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording). Binding Zulassungsordnung BLOCKED. Route B (record 4399_B): grade limit relaxed by 0.3 with at least 2 years of relevant professional experience after the bachelor's degree.

grade_requirement.note: ZulO § 1 Abs. 2 b: 'mindestens mit der Durchschnittsnote 2,3 bewerteten Abschlusses eines anderen Studienganges, der vergleichbare Kenntnisse vermittelt'. Route A = without the § 1 Abs. 3 professional-experience bonus.

items.raw_label: Anhang zu § 1 b): 'Mathematik / Physik 15' CP
Anhang zu § 1 b): 'Technische Mechanik 5' CP
Anhang zu § 1 b): 'Elektrotechnik 10' CP
Anhang zu § 1 b): 'Informatik/Programmiersprachen 5' CP
Anhang zu § 1 b): 'Automatisierungstechnik/Regelungstechnik 5' CP

subject_credit_requirements.note: ZulO § 1 Abs. 2 b with Anhang: comparable knowledge 'gelten insbesondere dann als nachgewiesen, wenn ... für die im Anhang genannten Fächer ... die dort aufgeführten Leistungspunkte erworben wurden'. The Anhang is a sufficient (not exclusive) test; GPU-R treats it as required (strictest reading, DECISION). § 1 Abs. 1 also names Analysis, lineare Algebra, Mechanik, Programmierung, Digitaltechnik, Regelungstechnik as required competences. Technische Mechanik = TAXONOMY GAP in eee (counts 0, strict). Replaces the programme-page values (mechanical engineering 5) used before the regulation was read.

conditional_admission.mechanism: ZulO § 3 Abs. 2: 'Im Fall des § 1 b) stellt die Auswahlkommission ... fest, ob vergleichbare Kenntnisse in den Fächern des Anhangs vorliegen und ob diesbezüglich Auflagen erteilt werden müssen.' Programme-level conditions rule with NO cap . § 2 Abs. 3 (180–209 CP: 20-week practice phase, 30 LP recognised) is a total-credit rule, not counted here. Koushik decision 17.10.2026: keep conditions allowed with no cap, because the university itself allows admission with missing subjects (this record only).

descriptive_notes: ZulO § 3 Abs. 1: places limited by capacity; if oversubscribed, ranking by the grade of the first degree, ties by lot; 5 % hardship quota (§ 3 Abs. 3).
§ 2 Abs. 3: degrees of 180–209 CP can be admitted with a ≥ 20-week practice phase in EE/mechatronics/informatics plus report (30 LP recognised), provable until end of 1st semester.
§ 2 Abs. 5: German A2 may be provided by enrolment (admission 'unter dem Vorbehalt').

allowed_exemptions: Bachelor's program with English as the medium of instruction (MOI)
language_english.note: ZulO § 1 Abs. 2 c: B2 CEFR, proof 'durch entsprechende Zeugnisse, IELTS, TOEFL, oder ein Studium in englischer Sprache'. Scores (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 72) from the programme page only.

other_requirements: German A2 accepted only from Goethe Institut, DSH, Test DaF, TELC, DAAD, UNIcert, ÖSD, DTZ (BAMF) or a German-university transcript; 'Certificates from other organisations will probably not be accepted!' (programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Admission Regulations of the Master course Electrical Engineering and Information Technology - international (Hochschule Darmstadt, Fachbereich Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik)
admission_regulation.version: English version published on the programme's Downloads page: 'dated 10/01/2012', 'last change on 08/12/2020' (changes effective 01.02.2021). FALLBACK: the binding German text of this version was not found (only the German version of 10.11.2015, Hochschulanzeiger 2016, seen in search, not opened). No 2024-2026 amendment found (web search of h-da.de / Hochschulanzeiger; Hochschulanzeiger index not opened).

accepted_degree_fields.note: Admission Regulations § 3 (4-semester): 'Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent degree in a suitable subject' 'obtained after passing a 6 semester course' 'with 180 CP pursuant to ECTS or a comparable learning achievement'; recognition generally via the Central Office for Foreign Education Systems (Anabin) or a partnership agreement; exceptions by the Admission Board; HRK country-specific rules (such as APS) apply. § 4 (3-semester): Bachelor in Electrical Engineering from h_da or equivalent suitable degree 'with 210 CP pursuant to ECTS' incl. 'at least 15 CP from practical phases'. International page: 'A bachelor degree in electrical engineering or equivalent with a minimum of 180 ECTS'. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: No grade limit in the Admission Regulations. International page: 'We do not have a mandatory GPA, as marks alone are hard to compare.' (h_da-internal applicants: page asks for a letter of recommendation with a grade of 2,2 or worse - not a limit.)

items.raw_label: § 2: suitable knowledge of electrical engineering 'as stipulated by the course module manual' (no CP)
§ 2: suitable knowledge of mathematics 'as stipulated by the course module manual' (no CP)
§ 2: suitable knowledge of information technology 'as stipulated by the course module manual' (no CP)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Admission Regulations § 2: assessment of suitable knowledge in electrical engineering, mathematics and information technology 'as stipulated by the course module manual'; no credit numbers -> presence-only items (Spec rule; R7: module manual not converted into numbers). Mapping 'information technology' -> general_cs is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Admission Regulations § 6 (11): 'If applicable, the applicant may be asked to fulfil additional requirements after starting the course of studies.' No cap and no deadline stated (max_ects null - flagged). 'Admission under reservation' = missing documents only. Koushik decision 17.10.2026: keep conditions allowed with no cap, because the university itself allows admission with missing subjects (this record only).

descriptive_notes: Admission Board assesses academic suitability: subject knowledge, Table of Results (and commendations), professional experience and relevant training (Admission Regulations); international page: 'Applicants will be selected by the admission board board, based on academic and professional records'; about 1500 applications a year; motivation letter evaluated.

language_english.note: Admission Regulations: 'Admission requires an adequate command of English certificate' (tests/levels published on the programme website). International page: 'TOEFL internet based score 88 or better'; IELTS (academic or general) 'minimum overall band score 6,5 or better' with no individual test below 6; not accepted: Language of tuition, IELTS one skill, PTE Academic, Cambridge O'Levels, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, TOEFL pB, TOEFL cB; 'The test should be not more than two years old.'

aps_certificate.note: International page: APS certificate required for visa and enrolment; applicants with an Indian degree apply via APS New Delhi; APS registration/submission dates to be entered in KOPLA. The page also mentions a new dMAT requirement for Indian applicants from 2027.

degree recognition (Anabin) generally required (§ 3)

program: Master's in Embedded Systems Engineering (ESE) — route A: Software Engineering at level 4
university: Dortmund University of Applied Sciences and Arts

admission_regulation.title: Studiengangsprüfungsordnung (StgPO) für den Masterstudiengang Embedded Systems Engineering an der Fachhochschule Dortmund (§ 4 Zugangsvoraussetzungen, Anlage 3 Kompetenzmatrix)
admission_regulation.version: LESEFASSUNG 'In der Fassung der 2. Änderungsordnung vom 15. Dezember 2022' (StgPO vom 16.05.2017, Neubekanntmachung 25.01.2021, Änderung 15.12.2022). Sechste Ordnung zur Änderung der StgPO vom 23.07.2026 (Amtliche Mitteilungen Nr. 32.11-062, 28.07.2026) opened: only deletes § 30 Abs. 1 - no effect on admission. 3rd-5th amendments not found (the 6th amendment cites only the 2017 order, the 2021 Neubekanntmachung and the 15.12.2022 amendment).

accepted_degree_fields.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'Der Abschluss eines Diplom- oder Bachelor-Studiengangs der (technischen) Informatik, der Elektrotechnik, der Informationstechnik oder eines fachlich nahen Studiengangs an einer Fachhochschule oder einer Universität oder der Abschluss eines entsprechenden akkreditierten Bachelorausbildungsgangs an einer Berufsakademie'. The previous programme must include relevant competences in Embedded Systems and software engineering per Anlage 3. Foreign degrees must include a comparable thesis (Thesis bzw. Diplomarbeit); the Fachausschuss decides in case of doubt.

grade_requirement.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'mit einer Gesamtnote von mindestens „gut“ (2,5).' No conversion method for foreign grades stated.

items.raw_label: Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld A Software Engineering - Stufe 2 'OOP (e.g. C++, Java), operating systems, RTOS, (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Modelling (UML), SW architectures, SW platforms (e.g. Java platform), (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'SW engineering, DSLs, model driven design, (min. 48 ECTS)'

Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld B Control Engineering - Stufe 2 'Mathematics for Control Systems (Laplace, Differential Equations), Linear Systems, (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Systems Modelling, Model-Based Controller Design, Matlab/Simulink, (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'Control Theory, Non-Linear Systems, Digital Control, (min. 48 ECTS)'

Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld C Signal Processing - Stufe 2 'Mathematics for Signal Processing, Filters (e.g. simple first order filters), (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Digital Filters, Model Based Design, Matlab/Simulink, (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'Signal Theory, Higher Order Filters, Digital Signal Processing, (min. 48 ECTS)'

Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld D Systems Engineering - Stufe 2 'Processes for Mechatronics Design, HW/SW Codesign, (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Systems Modelling, e.g. sysML, System Verilog, (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Requirements Engineering (RE), (min. 36 ECTS)'

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anlage 3 (Kompetenzmatrix): four fields A-D, five levels ('Die Stufen bauen aufeinander auf.'; 'Die Stufe 5 ist informatorisch.'). Qualifying combinations: (1) 'Kompetenzfelder A, B, C, D müssen alle mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein.' (2) 'FALLS ein Kompetenzfeld aus A, B, C, D nur auf Stufe 2 ist, müssen mindestens 2 Kompetenzfelder mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein.' Stufe 1 = min. 18 ECTS, Stufe 2 and 3 = min. 30 ECTS, Stufe 4 = min. 48 ECTS (D: 36). GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): in both combinations every field must be at least Stufe 2, i.e. min. 30 ECTS, so each field is stored with 30 ECTS. The additional rule that at least one field (combination 1) or two fields (combination 2) reach Stufe 4 (48 ECTS; Systems Engineering 36) and the content of each level cannot be checked by the engine and is NOT stored (DECISION). Fields C and D: TAXONOMY GAP (count 0 until the taxonomy phase). ROUTE SPLIT (Koushik decision 20.10.2026, same as approved 4879): combination 1 requires all four fields at level 3 (30 ECTS) AND one field at level 4; route A = Software Engineering at level 4 (48 ECTS), other fields 30. Combination 2 (one field at level 2 = 30 ECTS, two at level 4) is never easier in ECTS terms and is not stored. GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording). The programme is shown once with the student's best route. Categories (Koushik decision 20.10.2026, add-up rule — main + covered categories added together): every topic the regulation names in a field's levels is a sub-category of that field, because the levels build on each other ('Die Stufen bauen aufeinander auf') and the ECTS figures are running totals (GPU-R reading). A software_engineering + programming_practical_cs (OOP) + operating_systems (OS, RTOS); B control_systems + calculus_analysis (only 'Laplace, Differential Equations') + signals_systems ('Linear Systems'); C digital_signal_processing + signals_systems (signal theory, filters) + calculus_analysis + linear_algebra ('Mathematics for Signal Processing' names no topics; transforms and filters use both — Koushik decision 20.10.2026); D model_based_systems_engineering (MBSE, SysML) + digital_systems (HW/SW codesign, SystemVerilog) + software_engineering (Requirements Engineering) + mechatronics ('Processes for Mechatronics Design'). OVERLAP ALLOWED across fields A–D: the university names the same topics in several fields, so a course counts in every field whose categories it matches (D13 removed for all records, Koushik decision 20.10.2026). digital_signal_processing, signals_systems, model_based_systems_engineering, digital_systems, mechatronics = TAXONOMY GAPS (count 0 until the taxonomy phase).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions / Auflagen rule in StgPO § 4 or on the programme page.

descriptive_notes: Your degree is checked against a competency matrix in four fields (Software Engineering, Control Engineering, Signal Processing, Systems Engineering): all four at least level 3 with one at level 4, or one at level 2 with two at level 4 and one at level 3 (StgPO Anlage 3). Level 4 needs at least 48 ECTS in that field (Systems Engineering 36).
The Fachausschuss decides on doubts about degree equivalence and on equivalent English certificates (StgPO § 4).
All applicants (EU, German, non-EU) must submit their documents for a pre-check via precheck.go-study-europe.de (programme page).

allowed_exemptions: certificate equivalent to CEFR C1 (Fachausschuss decides on equivalence)
language_english.note: StgPO § 4 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: test taken 'innerhalb der letzten zwei Jahre vor Eingang der Bewerbung'; TOEFL-ITP 'mindestens 550 Punkten', TOEFL-iBT at least 90, IELTS at least 6.5 as equivalent test; alternatively a certificate 'entsprechend C1 des Gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmen'. No CEFR level stated as the general requirement (required_level null). Programme page gives the same scores.

other_requirements: Foreign degree must include a thesis comparable to German minimum quality standards (StgPO § 4 Abs. 1)
Pre-check of documents (go-study-europe.de)
VPD required for foreign certificates (programme page)
Application via portal.fh-dortmund.de

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 15 May - 15 July (programme page)

items.raw_label: Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld A Software Engineering - Stufe 2 'OOP (e.g. C++, Java), operating systems, RTOS, (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Modelling (UML), SW architectures, SW platforms (e.g. Java platform), (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'SW engineering, DSLs, model driven design, (min. 48 ECTS)'

Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld B Control Engineering - Stufe 2 'Mathematics for Control Systems (Laplace, Differential Equations), Linear Systems, (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Systems Modelling, Model-Based Controller Design, Matlab/Simulink, (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'Control Theory, Non-Linear Systems, Digital Control, (min. 48 ECTS)'

Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld C Signal Processing - Stufe 2 'Mathematics for Signal Processing, Filters (e.g. simple first order filters), (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Digital Filters, Model Based Design, Matlab/Simulink, (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'Signal Theory, Higher Order Filters, Digital Signal Processing, (min. 48 ECTS)'

Anlage 3 Kompetenzfeld D Systems Engineering - Stufe 2 'Processes for Mechatronics Design, HW/SW Codesign, (min. 30 ECTS)' / Stufe 3 'Systems Modelling, e.g. sysML, System Verilog, (min. 30 ECTS)'; Stufe 4 'Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Requirements Engineering (RE), (min. 36 ECTS)'

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anlage 3 (Kompetenzmatrix): four fields A-D, five levels ('Die Stufen bauen aufeinander auf.'; 'Die Stufe 5 ist informatorisch.'). Qualifying combinations: (1) 'Kompetenzfelder A, B, C, D müssen alle mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein.' (2) 'FALLS ein Kompetenzfeld aus A, B, C, D nur auf Stufe 2 ist, müssen mindestens 2 Kompetenzfelder mindestens auf Stufe 4 sein UND 1 Kompetenzfeld muss mindestens auf Stufe 3 sein.' Stufe 1 = min. 18 ECTS, Stufe 2 and 3 = min. 30 ECTS, Stufe 4 = min. 48 ECTS (D: 36). GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording): in both combinations every field must be at least Stufe 2, i.e. min. 30 ECTS, so each field is stored with 30 ECTS. The additional rule that at least one field (combination 1) or two fields (combination 2) reach Stufe 4 (48 ECTS; Systems Engineering 36) and the content of each level cannot be checked by the engine and is NOT stored (DECISION). Fields C and D: TAXONOMY GAP (count 0 until the taxonomy phase). ROUTE SPLIT (Koushik decision 20.10.2026, same as approved 4879): combination 1 requires all four fields at level 3 (30 ECTS) AND one field at level 4; route D = Systems Engineering at level 4 (36 ECTS), other fields 30. Combination 2 (one field at level 2 = 30 ECTS, two at level 4) is never easier in ECTS terms and is not stored. GPU-R arithmetic (not regulation wording). The programme is shown once with the student's best route. Categories (Koushik decision 20.10.2026, add-up rule — main + covered categories added together): every topic the regulation names in a field's levels is a sub-category of that field, because the levels build on each other ('Die Stufen bauen aufeinander auf') and the ECTS figures are running totals (GPU-R reading). A software_engineering + programming_practical_cs (OOP) + operating_systems (OS, RTOS); B control_systems + calculus_analysis (only 'Laplace, Differential Equations') + signals_systems ('Linear Systems'); C digital_signal_processing + signals_systems (signal theory, filters) + calculus_analysis + linear_algebra ('Mathematics for Signal Processing' names no topics; transforms and filters use both — Koushik decision 20.10.2026); D model_based_systems_engineering (MBSE, SysML) + digital_systems (HW/SW codesign, SystemVerilog) + software_engineering (Requirements Engineering) + mechatronics ('Processes for Mechatronics Design'). OVERLAP ALLOWED across fields A–D: the university names the same topics in several fields, so a course counts in every field whose categories it matches (D13 removed for all records, Koushik decision 20.10.2026). digital_signal_processing, signals_systems, model_based_systems_engineering, digital_systems, mechatronics = TAXONOMY GAPS (count 0 until the taxonomy phase).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No conditions / Auflagen rule in StgPO § 4 or on the programme page.

admission_regulation.version: FPOAT vom 26.04.2023 i.d.F. der Satzungen vom 30.04.2024 und 19.12.2024 (consolidated, re-opened 17.10.2026); search found no later Änderungssatzung (2025-2026). accepted_degree_fields.note: FPOAT § 48 Abs. 1 names no degree fields. Subject-specific degree ('Fachspezifischer Abschluss im Sinne des § 33 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 ABMPO/TF'): FAU B.Sc. Autonomy Technologies or an equivalent degree not substantially different in competence profile. Related degrees: 'werden andere Bachelorabschlüsse anerkannt, sofern diese den Nachweis folgender Kompetenzen beinhalten' (four blocks, see items). primary_fields = GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: Related (fachverwandt) degrees: invited to the online test only if the overall grade (or average so far) is 'mindestens „gut“ im Sinne des § 22 Abs. 4 ABMPO/TF' (FPOAT § 48 Abs. 4); ABMPO/TF § 22 Abs. 4: 'bei einem Durchschnitt über 1,5 bis 2,5 = gut'. Subject-specific degrees: direct admission at '2,00 oder besser' or module grade '2,7 oder besser' in two of nine modules, otherwise test without grade condition. No conversion method stated in FPOAT.

items.raw_label: Mathematik: mind. 22,5 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module B1 bis B3 der Anlage 1 (Mathematics I-III)

Mechatronik und Regelungstechnik: mind. 20 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module B8, B10, B11 und B16 der Anlage 1 (Mechatronic Components and Systems, Electric Drives, Sensors, Dynamical Systems and Control)
Elektrotechnik: mind. 15 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module B4 und B5 der Anlage 1 (Electrical Engineering I and II)

Informatik: mind. 20 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module B19, B20 und B24 der Anlage 1 (Algorithms, Programming, and Data Representation; System-level Programming; Machine Learning for Engineers I)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPOAT § 48 Abs. 1: the four blocks define a related degree. Applicants from other universities must submit module descriptions. Item 2 pooled: control_systems + electrical_machines_drives (Electric Drives B10; TAXONOMY GAP, counts 0 until the taxonomy phase) - GPU-R policy; batch-1 record had control_systems only. Module names from Anlage 1 (batch-1 reading). Categories (Koushik decision 20.10.2026, add-up rule — main + covered categories added together): Mechatronik und Regelungstechnik = control_systems + electrical_machines_drives (Electric Drives) + measurement_instrumentation (Sensors) + mechatronics (Mechatronic Components and Systems); Elektrotechnik (EE I and II: circuits, electro- and magnetostatics — GPU-R reading of the FAU module titles) = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory; Informatik = general_cs + algorithms_data_structures + programming_practical_cs + operating_systems (System-level Programming) + machine_learning_ai (Machine Learning for Engineers I). engineering.mechatronics = TAXONOMY GAP (counts 0 until the taxonomy phase). Koushik decision 20.10.2026: general_ee removed from Elektrotechnik (EE I and II) because general_ee now counts ALL EE subjects; item = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory. Koushik rule 20.10.2026: general_cs counts ALL CS subjects, so CS sub-categories under a general_cs main item are removed (redundant).

conditional_admission.mechanism: FPOAT § 48 has no Auflagen / Zugang unter Bedingung (re-checked 17.10.2026). ABMPO/TF § 33 Abs. 2 (faculty-wide): 'Sind ausgleichsfähige Unterschiede vorhanden, kann die Zugangskommission den Zugang unter der Bedingung aussprechen' ... 'bis zu maximal 20 ECTS-Punkten' (to be proven within one year) - a faculty-wide 'kann' rule only; owner rule: not stored as a condition. Shown as information. CHANGE vs batch-1 record (allowed true / 20).

descriptive_notes: Qualification assessment (FPOAT § 48 Abs. 3-4). Subject-specific degrees (FAU B.Sc. Autonomy Technologies or equivalent): direct admission with an average of 2,00 or better, or a module grade of 2,7 or better in at least two of: Electrical Engineering I, Electrical Engineering II, Mechatronic Components and Systems, Sensors, Signal Theory, Digital Signal Processing, Dynamical Systems and Control, Machine Learning for Control Systems, Electric Drives.

Related degrees with an overall grade of at least 'gut' (2,5 or better), and subject-specific applicants not admitted directly, take an online test: English, open-book, 60 minutes, on Human-System Interfaces, Networking & Collaboration, Planning & Control, Sensing & Perception and general engineering mathematics (especially analysis and linear algebra). Pass mark 'gut' or better; all others are deemed unsuitable and not admitted.
Programme page: the online test takes place twice during the application period.

admission_regulation.title: Fachprüfungsordnung für den Bachelor- und den Masterstudiengang Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik / Information and Communication Technology an der Technischen Fakultät der FAU (FPOIuK/ICT), § 44, with ABMPO/TF
admission_regulation.version: FPOIuK/ICT vom 21.09.2007, last amended by the Vierzehnte Änderungssatzung vom 26.04.2023 (in force the day after publication), which rewrote § 44 (read from the amendment text; no consolidated German version after 2022 located). Earlier consolidated English version i.d.F. 29.06.2022. No later amendment found by search; listing page not opened. ABMPO/TF vom 28.03.2024. Faculty-wide ABMPO/TF: consolidated version 28.03.2024 idF Satzung vom 26.09.2024 (https://www.doc.zuv.fau.de//L1/PO/Tech/Allgemeine_PO_Bachelor_Master/konsolidierte_Fassungen/ABMPO-TF_20240328_idF_20240926.pdf); § 22 Abs. 4, § 33 Abs. 2–3 unchanged (independent check 17.10.2026). German consolidated FPOIuK/ICT idF 26.04.2023 located by checker; § 44 matches (BLOCKED cleared).

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPOIuK/ICT § 44 Abs. 1: subject-specific = B.Sc. Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik or an essentially equivalent degree. 'Als fachverwandte Abschlüsse im Sinne des § 29 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 ABMPO/TechFak werden insbesondere Bachelorabschlüsse in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik und Informationstechnik sowie Informatik anerkannt, sofern diese den Nachweis folgender Kompetenzen beinhalten' (four blocks, see items). Programme page also names Computational Engineering and Industrial Engineering (ICS specialisation).

grade_requirement.note: FPOIuK/ICT § 44 Abs. 4: related-degree applicants are invited to the online test if 'deren Gesamtnote des Abschlusses bzw. deren Durchschnittsnote der bisherigen Leistungen mindestens „gut“' (ABMPO/TF § 22 Abs. 4: 'über 1,5 bis 2,5 = gut'); 'Die übrigen Bewerberinnen und Bewerber gelten als ungeeignet'. Subject-specific: direct admission at 2,00 or better or 2,7 in two core modules. No conversion method stated.

items.raw_label: Mathematik: mind. 20 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module 1 bis 4 der Anlage 1 dieser Fachprüfungsordnung (Mathematics for IuK 1-3, Stochastic processes)
Kommunikationstechnik: mind. 20 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module 18 bis 21 der Anlage 1 (Signals and systems I, II, Digital signal processing, Communication systems)

Elektrotechnik: mind. 20 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module 5, 14, 16 und 17 der Anlage 1 (Introduction to ICT, Digital technology, Electronics and circuit technology, Laboratory: Circuit technology)

Informatik: mind. 20 ECTS-Punkte, Kenntnisse analog zu denen der Module 6 bis 13 der Anlage 1 (Foundations of programming, Algorithms, Computer architecture, System programming, Discrete event systems, Algorithms for continuous systems, Computer communications, Software engineering)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPOIuK/ICT § 44 Abs. 1 (14th amendment 26.04.2023). Module names from the English consolidated version i.d.F. 29.06.2022, Anlage 1 (extraction partly garbled; the 2023 amendment's Anlage not seen). Item 2 pooled (communications + signals_systems + digital_signal_processing, the area's modules; TAXONOMY GAP for the two covered categories). Categories (Koushik decision 20.10.2026, add-up rule — main + covered categories added together): Elektrotechnik = electronics + circuit_theory + digital_systems (Digital technology); Informatik = general_cs + programming_practical_cs + algorithms_data_structures + computer_engineering (Computer architecture) + operating_systems (System programming) + computer_networks (Computer communications) + software_engineering. computer_networks and digital_systems = TAXONOMY GAPS (count 0 until the taxonomy phase). Koushik decision 20.10.2026: general_ee removed from Elektrotechnik because general_ee now counts ALL EE subjects; item = electronics + circuit_theory + digital_systems (Introduction to ICT has no specific category and is not counted). Koushik rule 20.10.2026: general_cs counts ALL CS subjects, so CS sub-categories under a general_cs main item are removed (redundant).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No Auflagen in FPOIuK/ICT § 44. ABMPO/TF § 33 Abs. 2 (faculty-wide): 'Sind ausgleichsfähige Unterschiede vorhanden, kann die Zugangskommission den Zugang unter der Bedingung aussprechen' ... 'bis zu maximal 20 ECTS-Punkten' (to be proven within one year) - a faculty-wide 'kann' rule only; owner rule: not stored as a condition. Shown as information. Programme page says related degrees 'can be admitted with additional courses' (CONFLICT note; regulation stored).

descriptive_notes: Online qualification test (FPOIuK/ICT § 44 Abs. 4) for related degrees with 'gut' (2,5) or better and subject-specific applicants not admitted directly: StudOn-Exam, 60 minutes, open-book, on systems theory, signal processing, communications, computer architecture and engineering mathematics; pass mark 'gut' or better; others not admitted.

Subject-specific degrees: direct admission with overall grade 2,00 or better, or 2,7 or better in at least two listed core modules (e.g. Stochastische Prozesse, Digitale Signalverarbeitung) (§ 44 Abs. 3).
Application page: the online exam takes place twice during the application period.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or first degree acquired in English
Medium of Instruction Certificate (programme page)
language_english.note: FPOIuK/ICT § 44 Abs. 2 (14th amendment): TOEFL 'mit mind. IBT 80 Punkten', IELTS 'mit mind. dem Ergebnis 6.0'. Programme page: B2 or equivalent tests or Medium of Instruction Certificate; IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80.

aps_certificate.note: FAU international Master's application page: 'For applicants with qualifications from India, the APS certificate must be submitted when applying for admission' (read 10.10.2026 in batch 1, not re-opened today).

other_requirements: Module descriptions (applicants from other universities, § 44 Abs. 3)
Online qualification test
Application via campo
Application before graduation possible with at least 140 ECTS (ABMPO/TF § 33 Abs. 3)

admission_regulation.title: Zugangs- und Auswahlordnung (ZAO) für den Masterstudiengang Microelectronic Systems (M.Sc.) an der Fachhochschule Westküste
admission_regulation.version: vom 11.02.2025, NBl. HS MBW Schl.-H. Nr. 03/2025 S. 37 (14.07.2025), in force the day after publication; applies from WS 2025/26. Replaces the Zugangsordnung MES (Stand 2013). PO MA MeS vom 11.02.2025 published together (not opened). No later amendment found by search.

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZAO § 2 Abs. 1: Bachelor in Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik, Information Engineering, Regenerative Energiesysteme und Energiemanagement, Informatik Technischer Systeme or Mechatronik (HAW Hamburg) or Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik (FH Westküste), or a comparable degree 'mit einem Umfang von mindestens 210 Leistungspunkten (CP)' in which 'mindestens 150 CP dem Bereich der Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik und/oder der Elektronik und/oder der Informations- und Elektrotechnik zuzuordnen sein'. Joint programme with HAW Hamburg: FH Westküste runs the summer intake, HAW Hamburg the winter intake.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in ZAO § 2; the grade is used only for ranking when oversubscribed (§ 5).

items.raw_label: ZAO § 2 Abs. 1: mindestens 150 CP 'dem Bereich der Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik und/oder der Elektronik und/oder der Informations- und Elektrotechnik' (comparable degrees)

subject_credit_requirements.note: One pooled area (and/or) -> one item. Koushik decision 20.10.2026: 'Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik und/oder Elektronik und/oder Informations- und Elektrotechnik' covers the whole of electrical/electronic engineering, so EVERY EE category counts: stored as general_ee alone (Koushik rule 20.10.2026: general_ee counts ALL EE subjects — circuit_theory, communications, control_systems, digital_signal_processing, digital_systems, electrical_machines_drives, electromagnetic_field_theory, electronics, information_theory, measurement_instrumentation, microelectronics_semiconductors, power_electronics, power_engineering, signals_systems; sub-categories removed as redundant). Mathematics, natural sciences, CS and humanities do NOT count. Taxonomy-gap categories among these count 0 until the taxonomy phase. Applies to comparable degrees; the named HAW/FHW degrees are accepted without this check.

conditional_admission.mechanism: ZAO § 2 Abs. 2: applicants with fewer than 210 but at least 180 CP may be admitted and must make up the difference 'innerhalb der ersten beiden Studiensemester' (form set by the Studienfachberatung) - total-credit top-up only, not a subject condition. § 2 Abs. 3: degree to be completed by the end of the first semester (provisional admission).

descriptive_notes: If oversubscribed, ranking by points (ZAO § 5): grade 1.0 = 30 points, 2.0 = 20, 3.0 = 10, 4.0 = 0 (one point per 0.1), plus up to 20 bonus points: relevant work experience of at least 20 weeks (up to 5), degree/study year at a German university or 3 months' work in Germany (5), specialisation in analogue/digital hardware design, RF/communications, embedded/real-time systems or circuit simulation/layout (up to 10).

allowed_exemptions: school-leaving certificate with English at least 'ausreichend'
English-speaking school or English-language school
admission to study in an English-speaking country / English-language programme
at least one year of successful study in English
at least half a year of post-graduate work or practical semester in an English-speaking company or abroad
language_english.note: ZAO § 3: English 'mindestens auf der Stufe B 2' of the CEFR; accepted proofs include TOEFL (iBT/ITP), IELTS (Academic), Cambridge CAE/CPE/FCE/BEC Higher, Linguaskill General and other proofs; no test scores stated (old record's IELTS 6.0 was a default, not from a source). No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (programme page and PO 2025, 24.10.2026).

other_requirements: 180-209 CP: missing credits to be made up within the first two semesters (ZAO § 2 Abs. 2)
Degree not yet completed: completion by the end of the first semester, with a certificate of completed/outstanding exams and average grade (ZAO § 2 Abs. 3)
Foreign degree: apply via uni-assist (programme page)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 November - 31 December (foreign degree, via uni-assist; programme page); ZAO § 4: 15 January (Ausschlussfrist)

admission_regulation.title: Zugangs- und Auswahlordnung für den Masterstudiengang Information and Communications Engineering (M.Sc.) an der Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften Hamburg, with the HAWAZO
admission_regulation.version: Vom 31. August 2026 (file name: Hochschulanzeiger Nr. 233, 28.09.2026); new ordinance, in force the day after publication; § 8: 'Sie gilt erstmalig für Bewerbungsverfahren zum Sommersemester 2027.' Replaces for the next cycle the ZAO vom 21. Mai 2025 (HA 216, 28.05.2025; applied from WS 2025/26 up to WS 2026/27), which had a 150-CP subject rule now dropped. Searched HAW Hochschulanzeiger/ZAO listings 2024-2026: only these two versions found. HAWAZO § 7 (English proof) not opened.

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZAO 2026 § 2 Abs. 1: 'erfolgreiche Abschluss eines mindestens siebensemestrigen (210 Leistungspunkte) berufsqualifizierenden Bachelor- oder Diplomstudiums in einem Studiengang Elektrotechnik oder in einem verwandten Studiengang, beispielsweise Elektro- und Informationstechnik und Information Engineering.' Previous ZAO 2025 (WS 2025/26–WS 2026/27): named HAW degrees (Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik, Information Engineering, Regenerative Energiesysteme und Energiemanagement, Informatik Technischer Systeme, Mechatronik) or comparable with ≥ 210 CP, of which 'mindestens 150 CP dem Bereich der Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik und/oder der Elektronik und/oder der Informations- und Elektrotechnik zuzuordnen sein'. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in the ZAO 2026 (or 2025); the grade only enters the ranking (§ 4).

subject_credit_requirements.note: ZAO 2026 requires only a degree in Elektrotechnik or a related programme, no subject credit numbers → no subject items (owner rule; exam board/Studierendensekretariat judges 'verwandt'). DECISION: the 2025 ZAO's 150-CP rule (ICT and/or electronics and/or EE) is not stored because the 2026 ZAO applies to the next application cycle (SS 2027).

conditional_admission.mechanism: ZAO 2026 § 2 Abs. 2: degrees with 180–209 LP admitted 'unter der auflösenden Bedingung', the difference to 210 LP to be made up by the last day of the 2nd semester (form set by the Auswahlkommission, § 11 Abs. 1 Satz 2 HAWAZO); in this case German B2 is additionally required. Total-credit rule only → not a subject condition (lesson 8).

descriptive_notes: If oversubscribed: ranking by points = grade points (HAWAZO annex; grade to one decimal, not rounded) + up to 20 bonus points (ZAO 2026 § 4).

Bonus: up to 8 points for ≥ 20 weeks relevant practical work during/after the first degree; up to 12 points for modules of ≥ 5 CP each in analog/digital hardware design, RF and communications engineering, embedded/real-time systems, circuit simulation/layout (ZAO 2026 § 4 Abs. 3). Ties by lot.
Applicants with fewer than 210 LP (≥ 180) must make up the difference within two semesters and additionally prove German B2 (ZAO 2026 § 2 Abs. 2).

allowed_exemptions: Abitur/Fachhochschulreife with English at least 'ausreichend'
school diploma from an English-speaking school abroad
admission to an English-language degree programme
at least one year of successful study in an English-language programme or abroad in English
at least 6 months post-graduate work or internship abroad in English or at an English-speaking company
language_english.note: ZAO 2026 § 3: English B2 'entsprechend der Vorgaben in § 7 der HAWAZO'. Accepted tests/scores are in HAWAZO § 7 (not opened) → scores null. Programme page: 'proof of proficiency in English at the B2 level' of the CEFR, no scores. HAWAZO vom 25.06.2025 (Hochschulanzeiger Nr. 220/2025, § 7 Abs. 5; from SS 2027) opened by checker: lists accepted proofs; sets no minimum TOEFL/IELTS scores (null correct). https://www.haw-hamburg.de/fileadmin/zentrale_PDF/Hochschulanzeiger/2025/Hochschulanzeiger_Nr._220-2025_vom_17._Juli_2025.pdf No IELTS/TOEFL minimum in the ZAO (28.05.2025: B2; details in § 7 HAWAZO, not opened).

other_requirements: German B2 only for applicants with 180–209 LP (ZAO 2026 § 2 Abs. 2 Satz 2)

applicants not yet graduated may apply if the degree is expected by the end of the 1st Master semester; certificate of completed/outstanding exams with average grade; degree proof by the last day of the 1st semester (ZAO 2026 § 2 Abs. 3)
foreign degree: VPD from uni-assist, application via myHAW (HAW international applicants page)
Diploma Supplement / Transcript of Records (programme page)

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZAO § 2 Abs. 1 a): Bachelor in 'Umwelttechnik oder Verfahrenstechnik oder verwandte Studiengänge' with 'mindestens 210 Leistungspunkten'; b) degree in 'einer den Masterstudiengängen nahestehenden technischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen' Fachrichtung with ≥ 210 LP. language_english.note: ZAO § 2 Abs. 1 c) + Anlage 2: TOEFL 'score 87 (internet based)', IELTS 'band 5.5', CAE 'C', CPE 'C', FCE 'C'. Programme page: same scores. No CEFR level stated in the ZAO.

admission_regulation.title: Satzung über das Studium an der Technischen Universität Hamburg (TUHH) vom 27. Februar 2013 (§ 2 Zugang zu Master-Studiengängen; Anhang 1 Sprachkenntnisse; Anhang 2 Fachspezifische Anforderungen) with Anhang 2 'Fachspezifische Anforderungen für den Master-Studiengang Information and Communication Systems'
admission_regulation.version: Lesefassung 'zuletzt geändert am 17. Juni 2026' (16th amendment, Amtlicher Anzeiger Nr. 47 vom 16. Juni 2026, S. 698); Lesefassung is 'nicht rechtsverbindlich' (fn. 1). Amendment list in the Lesefassung includes 2024-2026 changes (22.11.2023, 28.02.2024, 29.05.2024 all AA Nr. 79/2024; 31.07./25.09.2024 AA Nr. 14/2025; 18.12.2024 AA Nr. 27/2025; 23.04.2025 AA Nr. 38/2025; 22.10.2025 AA Nr. 93/2025; 17.06.2026 AA Nr. 47/2026); individual amendment texts not opened. § 2 read in the 2026 Lesefassung. Anhang 2 entry for this programme could NOT be read in the 2026 Lesefassung (text extraction truncated at Anhang 2.2.4); subject values taken from the programme-specific Anhang 2 sheet 'in der Fassung vom 28. Oktober / 25. November 2015 (Amtlicher Anzeiger Nr. 5 vom 19. Januar 2016)', which the official admission-requirements page still links (currency check resolved: see next sentence). Lesefassung 17.06.2026 read 18.10.2026 (text supplied by Koushik): Anhang 2.2.9 values match the record. Anhang 1 table layout is broken in the text copy; by content the table listing ICS/MMS (with Data Science, Mechatronics, etc.) is C3 'international ausgerichtete Master-Studiengänge' (the separate 3-row table BAAI/EMAJ/MBA is C4 'weiterbildende') → § 2 Abs. 3 grade rule and § 3 Abs. 1 deadline (01 Feb, winter only) apply.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Programme page: 'Applicants should hold a Bachelor's or equivalent degree in engineering', 'preferably specializing in electrical or computer engineering'. Satzung § 2 Abs. 1: completed undergraduate degree plus 'fachspezifische Kenntnisse und Kompetenzen, die in Umfang und Tiefe den Anforderungen' of the programme correspond (Anhang 2). TUHH's own B.Sc. Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Science in Engineering and Electrical Engineering lead consecutively into ICS (programme page). primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: Satzung über das Studium (Lesefassung 17.06.2026) § 2 Abs. 3: applicants for the C3 international master programmes with a foreign degree 'haben eine Benotung mindestens im oberen Leistungsviertel des jeweiligen Hochschulsystems nachzuweisen'. ICS and MMS are C3 (same 10 programmes as TUHH's guide 'How to apply for the international master's programs 2026'). TUHH publishes no number; programme pages: 'very good previous academic performance', pre-check of GPA against 'very strict requirements'. GPU-R conversion (Koushik decision 18.10.2026): upper quarter of the Indian passing range 5–10 = CGPA ≥ 8,75 → modified Bavarian 1 + 3 × (10 − 8,75)/(10 − 5) = 1,75.

items.raw_label: Anhang 2 ICS: 'Mathematik' — Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Statistik, Optimierung und Diskrete Mathematik: 16 CP

Anhang 2 ICS: Telekommunikation (z. B. Feldtheorie, Antennen, Nachrichtentechnik, Computernetze), Signalverarbeitung (z. B. digitale Signalverarbeitung, Filter), Software (z. B. Programmierung, Softwaretechnik, Softwareanalyse, Data Mining, Betriebssysteme), Informatik (z. B. Algorithmen, formale Sprachen, Logik, Rechnerarchitekturen, Zustandsautomaten, verteilte und eingebettete Systeme), Ingenieur- und Naturwissenschaften (z. B. Systemtheorie, Mechanik, Regelungstechnik, Physik) — footnote: 'In these subjects at least 74 credit points are required in total'

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anhang 2 sheet (Fassung 28.10./25.11.2015, AA Nr. 5/2016), linked from the official admission-requirements page. Item 2 is one pooled total (74 CP across five sub-areas, no per-sub-area number; topics given only as 'z. B.') → one item with main + covered categories (POOLED, owner rule). The PDF prints the total as '741' = 74 with footnote 1. electromagnetic_field_theory, signals_systems, mechanics_dynamics, general_mechanical = TAXONOMY GAP (count 0 until taxonomy phase). Koushik decision 20.10.2026 (add-up rule — main + covered categories added together): all topics named as 'z. B.' in the five sub-areas count — added digital_signal_processing (DSP, filters), software_engineering, operating_systems, algorithms_data_structures, theoretical_cs (formal languages, logic, automata), computer_engineering (computer architectures, embedded systems), computer_networks (Computernetze), machine_learning_ai (data mining). digital_signal_processing, computer_networks = TAXONOMY GAPS. Values confirmed against the Satzung Lesefassung 17.06.2026, Anhang 2.2.9. 22.10.2026 (Koushik, R15): 74-CP item cleaned — general_ee / general_cs / general_mechanical cover all core subjects of their fields, so their sub-categories were removed; physics kept explicitly (Naturwissenschaften). Meaning and verdicts unchanged.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Satzung § 2 Abs. 2a: admission with individual Angleichleistungen ('soll zwölf Leistungspunkte nicht überschreiten', to be completed by the end of the 2nd semester) applies only to 'einem deutschsprachigen oder anteilig englischsprachigen Master-Studiengang' (Anhang 1). This programme is taught entirely in English (guide April 2026: 'The international Master's degree courses are conducted in English language'), so the rule does not apply.

descriptive_notes: Subject-specific suitability is checked by an Auswahlkommission (Satzung § 2 Abs. 2).

If places are restricted: 10 % hardship quota; remaining places 90 % by Leistungsquote (grade of the first degree and degree of subject suitability per Anhang 2; +15 points for 'besondere fachliche Eignung') and 10 % by waiting time (Satzung §§ 14–14b).
Pre-check during the application period examines the cumulative GPA; passing it does not guarantee admission (guide April 2026).
Only one Master's programme per application period; if more are submitted, only the first is considered (guide April 2026).

allowed_exemptions: German school-leaving qualification (Abitur) or a state-recognised school qualification from AT/CH/LI (Anhang 1 B)
school qualification from US, UK, CA, AU, NZ or IE (Anhang 1 B)
degree from a German university, from AT/CH/LI, or from an English-speaking country listed (Anhang 1 B)
degree from an EEA country with confirmation that English was the language of instruction, completed there (Anhang 1 B)

TUHH guide (April 2026): TOEFL ITP and TOEFL Essentials 'will not be accepted'; proof required even if English is an official language of the applicant's country. A degree taught in English outside the listed countries is not an exemption in Anhang 1 B (moi_not_accepted left null: not stated in these words).

applicants with unfinished degrees: only if no more than one semester is left until graduation (guide April 2026)
self-test recommended before applying (programme page)

admission_regulation.version: Lesefassung 'zuletzt geändert am 17. Juni 2026' (16th amendment, Amtlicher Anzeiger Nr. 47 vom 16. Juni 2026, S. 698); Lesefassung is 'nicht rechtsverbindlich' (fn. 1). Amendment list in the Lesefassung includes 2024-2026 changes (22.11.2023, 28.02.2024, 29.05.2024 all AA Nr. 79/2024; 31.07./25.09.2024 AA Nr. 14/2025; 18.12.2024 AA Nr. 27/2025; 23.04.2025 AA Nr. 38/2025; 22.10.2025 AA Nr. 93/2025; 17.06.2026 AA Nr. 47/2026); individual amendment texts not opened. § 2 read in the 2026 Lesefassung. Oktober / 25. November 2015 (Amtlicher Anzeiger Nr. 5 vom 19. Januar 2016)', which the official admission-requirements page still links (currency check resolved: see next sentence). Lesefassung 17.06.2026 read 18.10.2026 (text supplied by Koushik): Anhang 2.2.14 values match the record. Anhang 1 table layout is broken in the text copy; by content the table listing ICS/MMS (with Data Science, Mechatronics, etc.) is C3 'international ausgerichtete Master-Studiengänge' (the separate 3-row table BAAI/EMAJ/MBA is C4 'weiterbildende') → § 2 Abs. 3 grade rule and § 3 Abs. 1 deadline (01 Feb, winter only) apply.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Programme page: 'Bachelor's or equivalent degree in engineering - preferably specializing in electrical engineering', 'sufficient proficiency in English'. Satzung § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: subject knowledge per Anhang 2. TUHH's B.Sc. Allgemeine Ingenieurwissenschaften – Vertiefung Elektrotechnik, Engineering Science – Specialization Electrical Engineering and Electrical Engineering lead consecutively into MMS (programme page). primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: Satzung über das Studium (Lesefassung 17.06.2026) § 2 Abs. 3: applicants for the C3 international master programmes with a foreign degree 'haben eine Benotung mindestens im oberen Leistungsviertel des jeweiligen Hochschulsystems nachzuweisen'. ICS and MMS are C3 (same 10 programmes as TUHH's guide 'How to apply for the international master's programs 2026'). TUHH publishes no number; programme pages: 'very good previous academic performance', pre-check of GPA against 'very strict requirements'. GPU-R conversion (Koushik decision 18.10.2026): upper quarter of the Indian passing range 5–10 = CGPA ≥ 8,75 → modified Bavarian 1 + 3 × (10 − 8,75)/(10 − 5) = 1,75.

items.raw_label: Anhang 2 MMS 'Mathematics' total 30 CP: Analysis (e.g. Taylor series, Fourier analysis, Stokes´ theorem) 8; Linear algebra (e.g. Gaussian elimination, eigenvalues, eigenvectors) 8; Differential and partial differential equations 8; Complex Functions 6
Anhang 2 MMS 'Computer Science': Procedural Programming 6 + Object oriented programming, algorithms and data structures 6
Anhang 2 MMS 'Computer Science': Computer engineering 6
Anhang 2 MMS 'Control Theory': Control theory (time and frequency domain, first and second order systems, frequency response, root locus, Nyquist stability, PID controller) 6
Anhang 2 MMS 'Physics': Physics for Engineers 6
Anhang 2 MMS 'Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering': Electrical engineering (e.g. direct & alternating current, electronics) 12
Anhang 2 MMS 'Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering': Circuit theory 6
Anhang 2 MMS 'Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering': Semiconductor circuit design and electronic devices 6
Anhang 2 MMS 'Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering': Materials in electrical engineering 3
Anhang 2 MMS 'Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering': Measurements: Methods and data processing 3
Anhang 2 MMS 'Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering': Transmission lines 6 + Theoretical electrical engineering 12
Anhang 2 MMS 'Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering': Signals and systems 6

subject_credit_requirements.note: Anhang 2 sheet (Fassung 28.10./25.11.2015, AA Nr. 5/2016), columns 'Field Requirements' / 'Required CP', area totals Mathematics 30, Computer Science 18, Control Theory 6, Physics 6, Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering 54 (sum 114 = GPU-R arithmetic; the sheet states no overall total). Module-by-module split with each module's stated CP: GPU-R policy (not regulation wording; Koushik's decision R1); maths kept as one total item (R1/R6). Modules mapping to the same category combined (R2): programming 6+6 = 12; transmission lines 6 + theoretical EE 12 = electromagnetic_field_theory 18. 'e.g.' here introduces topic examples, not the CP number (CP binding). TAXONOMY GAP (count 0 until taxonomy phase): computer_science_informatics.computer_engineering, chemistry_materials.materials_science, measurement_instrumentation, circuit_theory, electromagnetic_field_theory, signals_systems, electronics. Area totals (CS 18, EE 54) not stored separately (they equal the sum of the module items). Koushik decision 20.10.2026: each mandatory module is its own item with its own main category, so every module affects the verdict and no category appears in two items: Electrical engineering 12 ('e.g. direct & alternating current, electronics') = circuit_theory + electronics (add-up; Koushik decision 20.10.2026, following the university's wording — general_ee would count all EE subjects). These categories also appear in the separate Circuit theory 6 and Semiconductor 6 items (overlap allowed, D13 removed); Circuit theory 6 = circuit_theory; Semiconductor circuit design and electronic devices 6 = electronics + microelectronics_semiconductors (add-up within the module). Programming 12 also covers algorithms_data_structures ('Object oriented programming, algorithms and data structures'). Values confirmed against the Satzung Lesefassung 17.06.2026, Anhang 2.2.14.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Satzung § 2 Abs. 2a: admission with individual Angleichleistungen ('soll zwölf Leistungspunkte nicht überschreiten', to be completed by the end of the 2nd semester) applies only to 'einem deutschsprachigen oder anteilig englischsprachigen Master-Studiengang' (Anhang 1). This programme is taught entirely in English (guide April 2026: 'The international Master's degree courses are conducted in English language'), so the rule does not apply.

descriptive_notes: Subject-specific suitability is checked by an Auswahlkommission (Satzung § 2 Abs. 2).

If places are restricted: 10 % hardship quota; remaining places 90 % by Leistungsquote (grade of the first degree and degree of subject suitability per Anhang 2; +15 points for 'besondere fachliche Eignung') and 10 % by waiting time (Satzung §§ 14–14b).
Pre-check during the application period examines the cumulative GPA; passing it does not guarantee admission (guide April 2026).
Only one Master's programme per application period; if more are submitted, only the first is considered (guide April 2026).

allowed_exemptions: German school-leaving qualification (Abitur) or a state-recognised school qualification from AT/CH/LI (Anhang 1 B)
school qualification from US, UK, CA, AU, NZ or IE (Anhang 1 B)
degree from a German university, from AT/CH/LI, or from an English-speaking country listed (Anhang 1 B)
degree from an EEA country with confirmation that English was the language of instruction, completed there (Anhang 1 B)
language_english.note: Satzung § 17 Abs. 5 Nr. 3 + Anhang 1 B (programmes taught only in English): 'Ein gültiges TOEFL-Ergebnis (Mindestpunktzahl 90 [iBT])', 'Ein gültiges IELTS-Academics-Ergebnis (mindestens 6.5 Punkte)', Cambridge CPE, Cambridge CAE, 'telc English C1', 'UNIcert English level III'. § 17 Abs. 5: 'Der Sprachnachweis sollte in der Regel nicht älter sein als zwei Jahre.' TUHH guide (April 2026): TOEFL ITP and TOEFL Essentials 'will not be accepted'; proof required even if English is an official language of the applicant's country. A degree taught in English outside the listed countries is not an exemption in Anhang 1 B (moi_not_accepted left null: not stated in these words).

aps_certificate.note: TUHH 'How to apply' guide (April 2026, WS 2026 intake): APS required for applicants with a school or university degree from India (also China, Vietnam), regardless of nationality; holders of DAAD or other recognised German/EU-funded scholarships 'might be exempted'.

admission_regulation.version: Studienordnung 09/2025: for students first enrolled from WS 2025/26 (§ 12 Abs. 2); replaces the Studienordnung 06/2020 (last amended 12/2024), which expires 30.09.2027. Zulassungs- und Auswahlsatzung RES 10/2020 (Hochschulversammlung 15.07.2020, approved by the Ministry 29.07.2020), for students from WS 2020/21. accepted_degree_fields.note: Studienordnung 09/2025 § 3 Abs. 2 + Anlage 1 (and Satzung 10/2020 § 4 Abs. 1): a 'geeignetes Studium' as B.Eng./B.Sc. — suitable bachelors for RES: Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Regenerative Energietechnik (Satzung 2020: 'oder einem fachlich vergleichbaren berufsqualifizierenden Hochschulabschluss'); for degrees not listed the Prüfungsausschuss decides (§ 3 Abs. 6). 210 ECTS (or Diplom 240), or 180 ECTS with the 30-ECTS qualification semester (Anlage 1 Abs. 3). primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy).

grade_requirement.note: Studienordnung 09/2025 § 3 Abs. 3 (= Satzung 10/2020 § 4 Abs. 2): a 'qualifizierter Studienabschluss' is required: the applicant 'zu den besten 35 % der Absolventen seines Studiengangs gehört' (ECTS grading table, linear interpolation) or 'das Studium mit der Gesamtnote 2,5 oder besser abgeschlossen wurde' (foreign grades converted).
