descriptive_notes: Admission-restricted programme (Studienordnung 09/2025 Anlage 1, § 3 Abs. 7; Satzung 10/2020 § 5; 46 places in the 1st subject semester for WS 2026/27 under the Satzung zur Festsetzung von Zulassungszahlen of 25.06.2026). If applications exceed places, ranking by grade with upgrades: 210 ECTS 0.2; proven scientific publications (bachelor thesis or article) 0.1; basic German (A1) 0.1.

German as a Foreign Language is a module of the qualification semester, not an admission requirement

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang International Energy Engineering an der Ostbayerischen Technischen Hochschule Amberg-Weiden vom 01.07.2021
admission_regulation.version: SPO vom 01.07.2021, in force 01.10.2021 for students starting WS 2021/22 or later (§ 13); amended by 'Erste Satzung zur Änderung der Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang International Energy Engineering' vom 22.07.2026 (Senat 15.07.2026, bekanntgegeben 23.07.2026, in force the day after, for students starting WS 2026/27 or later). The amendment changes admission only in: § 5 Abs. 2 ('Bauingenieurwesen' deleted from the relevant degrees), § 5 Abs. 3 (deadline 15 July -> 01 June), § 5 Abs. 5 (English test list replaced by a reference to § 3 Abs. 6 Satz 2 Immatrikulationssatzung), § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 Satz 5 deleted (ASPO retake reference); grade, 20-ECTS competence rule and aptitude procedure unchanged.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: completed degree of at least six theoretical semesters, 'in der Regel 210 ECTS-Punkte, mindestens jedoch 180 ECTS-Punkte'. § 5 Abs. 2: 'Als einschlägig gelten ingenieurwissenschaftliche Studiengänge wie z. B. Energietechnik, Erneuerbare Energien,' environmental technology, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, process engineering, supply engineering, industrial engineering with a technical focus or equivalent (civil engineering deleted by the 2026 amendment). The Prüfungskommission decides on relevance. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: SPO § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'Gesamtprüfungsleistung von 2,5 oder besser'; foreign grades converted with the modified Bavarian formula (ASPO). The Prüfungskommission 'kann beschließen' that the grade criterion is met for applicants among the best 40 % of their graduating cohort (not checkable by the engine). The aptitude procedure (§ 6) must also be passed with at least 'gut' (2.5).

items.raw_label: Kompetenzen im Umfang von mindestens 20 ECTS-Leistungspunkten aus folgenden Kompetenzfeldern: Mathematik, Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik, Grundlagen der Thermodynamik, Grundlagen der Strömungsmechanik, Grundlagen der Chemie, Grundlagen der Physik, Informatik/Programmierung (SPO § 5 Abs. 2)

subject_credit_requirements.note: One pooled 20-ECTS requirement across the seven fields (not 20 in each). The Prüfungskommission decides whether the competences are relevant (§ 5 Abs. 2 Satz 2). Thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and chemistry are TAXONOMY GAPs (count 0 until the taxonomy phase). Koushik decision 21.10.2026: 'Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik' = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory (EE basics), not general_ee (which counts ALL EE subjects); add-up rule across the pool.

conditional_admission.mechanism: None for subject gaps. SPO § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 Sätze 2-7: holders of 180-209 ECTS make up missing practical competences by professional practice and missing theoretical competences by Bachelor modules set by the Prüfungskommission (programme page: 30 ECTS bridge modules, winter only), proof by the end of the 2nd semester or exmatriculation. This tops up total credits to 210 only.

descriptive_notes: Aptitude procedure (SPO § 6): 60 % grade of the first degree, 40 % specific aptitude and experience in energy technology (research/project work max 10 points, up to 5 per project; practical experience max 10 points, 0.5 per week); passed if the result is at least 'gut' (2.5). One reapplication allowed; a third application is excluded.
No aptitude procedure for a first degree 'besser als 1,3' or for the best 10 % of the programme's graduates (§ 6 Abs. 8).

allowed_exemptions: higher education entrance qualification or degree obtained in English (programme page; SPO 2021 § 5 Abs. 5)
German applicants: Abitur grade in English (2026 amendment, § 5 Abs. 5)
language_english.note: SPO § 5 Abs. 5 (2021): B2; 'TOEFL ... mit einer Punktzahl von mindestens 81', IELTS 6, TOEIC 780, or equivalent proof (e.g. modules in the degree certificate). The 2026 amendment (for WS 2026/27+) replaces the test list with a reference to § 3 Abs. 6 Satz 2 of the Immatrikulationssatzung (not read). Programme page: 'at least on level B2', TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6, TOEIC 780. CONFLICT TOEFL 81 (SPO 2021) vs 80 (programme page): higher score stored (Koushik rule: take the higher English score, 21.10.2026); IELTS 6 in both.

aps_certificate.note: Programme page: 'The APS certificate is mandatory before UniAssist will provide you with your' VPD.

other_requirements: VPD from uni-assist specific to OTH Amberg-Weiden, submitted within the application period (programme page)
holders of 180-209 ECTS: bridge modules / practical competences to reach 210 ECTS by the end of the 2nd semester, start in winter only (SPO § 4 Abs. 3, § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 1)
tuition service fee EUR 500 per semester for non-EU students plus EUR 87 semester fee (programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Studien- und Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang „Advanced Semiconductor Nanotechnologies“ vom 16. Mai 2023, with the Satzung zur Durchführung des hochschulinternen Auswahlverfahrens im Masterstudiengang Advanced Semiconductor Nanotechnologies vom 16. Mai 2023
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 40/2023 (published 05.06.2023), in force the day after publication, for students enrolled from WS 2023/24 (§§ 34, 35). The OVGU regulations listing (Prüfungsordnungen, media 20114) shows only the 16.05.2023 SPO (DE/EN), no amendment; a web search of bekanntmachungen.ovgu.de for 2024-2026 amendments found none. Selection statute (Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 29/2023) read 21.10.2026 via the English information version supplied by Koushik.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 1 a: 'Nachweis eines Bachelorabschlusses, eines Hochschuldiploms oder eines vergleichbaren Abschlusses' ... 'in einem einschlägigen Studiengang im Fach Physik oder Elektrotechnik oder in einem eng verwandten Fach'. Programme page: 'B. Sc. or university diploma or comparable degree in electrical engineering/physics'. primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade: SPO § 4 sets none, and the selection statute (Satzung 16.05.2023, § 4 Abs. 1 b; English information version supplied by Koushik 21.10.2026) uses the grade only for ranking points (1,00–1,50 = 40; 1,51–2,00 = 30; 2,01–2,50 = 10; > 2,50 = 0) — a grade worse than 2,5 earns 0 points but does not exclude.

items.raw_label: Mathematical skills on the level of a B. Sc. in electrical engineering or related study programme (programme page; not in the SPO)

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPO § 4 lists no subject credit requirements. The presence-only maths item comes from the programme page ('Mathematical skills on the level of a B. Sc. in electrical engineering or related study programme is prerequisite') — GPU-R policy (not regulation wording) to store it.

conditional_admission.mechanism: SPO § 4 Abs. 9: 'Bei Zulassung werden in der Regel durch den Prüfungsausschuss eine oder zwei verpflichtende Lehrveranstaltungen (sog. Harmonisierungskurse I+II) bekanntgegeben', to be completed 'im 1. Fachsemester', 'um bestehende Kenntnislücken in Disziplinen zu beseitigen, die für das erfolgreiche Studium grundlegend sind.' Cap 10 = GPU-R arithmetic: Regelstudienplan lists 'Eingangsharmonisierung' Kurs 1 parts 1/2 and 2/2, 5 CP each, semester 1 (inside the 120 CP curriculum).

descriptive_notes: Admission-restricted: ranking by points, max. 100 (selection statute 16.05.2023 § 4): (a) first degree — Physics or Electrical Engineering 40, Mathematics/Computer Science/Chemistry/other engineering 30; (b) overall grade — 1,00–1,50 = 40, 1,51–2,00 = 30, 2,01–2,50 = 10, worse than 2,50 = 0; (c) 5 points per completed subject from Quantum Mechanics, Solid State Physics, Chemistry, Electronics (max. 10) — applicants who cannot prove these get points from the subject GRE in Physics or Chemistry instead (90–100 % = 10, 60–89 % = 5, below 50 % = 0); (d) motivation letter up to 10 points.
40 % of places are reserved for foreign applicants (§ 3 Abs. 2).
Motivation letter in English, maximum 1000 words (SPO § 4 Abs. 1 c).

allowed_exemptions: degree under Abs. 1 a obtained in a relevant English-taught programme (SPO § 4 Abs. 6)
equivalence determined by the Prüfungsausschuss in exceptional cases (SPO § 4 Abs. 6)
language_english.note: SPO § 4 Abs. 6: 'TOEFL ... mindestens 550 Punkte (altes Testverfahren), 213 Punkte (Computertestverfahren seit 1998), 79-80 Punkte (internetbasiert)', 'IELTS ... Punktzahl 6,0', 'Certificate of Proficiency in English B', 'Certificate of Advanced English C'. TOEFL stored as 80 (strictest reading of '79-80'). Programme page: 'Proof of English language skills at B2-level' and links the OVGU Referenzrahmen 2026 (B2 row: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 85, PTE 70) — CONFLICT with the SPO (IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 79-80): higher scores stored — IELTS 6.5, TOEFL 85, PTE 70 (Koushik rule: take the higher English score, 21.10.2026).

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants applying from outside the EU (SPO § 4 Abs. 1 d)
standardized_test_requirements.details: SPO § 4 Abs. 1 d: 'Nachweis (score card) des Graduate Record Examination Test (GRE) in Physik oder Chemie, soweit die Bewerbung von außerhalb der EU erfolgt'. admission_regulation.version: PO Automation & Control vom 15.06.2021 (Verkündungsblatt 4/2021 pp. 55 ff.) — § 2 / § 2a read 18.10.2026 from text supplied by Koushik; amendments 8/2023 (§ 2 Abs. 1 S. 2 + Abs. 5 wording) and 6/2025 (§ 2 Abs. 2: provisional admission wording) read earlier — no change to Abs. 3, 6 or § 2a.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 + Abs. 3: bachelor in Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik or a related field, equivalent to the TU Kaiserslautern EIT bachelor ('kein schematischer Vergleich, sondern eine Gesamtbetrachtung'); missing modules up to 20 LP as Auflagen (§ 2a). Programme page (eit.rptu.de/ac/bewerbung): 'ein abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium der Elektrotechnik, der Informationstechnik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung'. Not copied to the CS file (Koushik decision 21.10.2026: CS students usually miss more than the 20 LP of EE modules allowed as Auflagen). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 2 Abs. 3: 'Das Bachelorstudium soll mit einem CGPA von mindestens 3,5 (von maximal 4,0) oder einer vergleichbaren Gesamtnote abgeschlossen worden sein.' RPTU publishes no conversion. GPU-R arithmetic (Koushik decision 18.10.2026): modified Bavarian formula with Nmin 2,0 on the 4-point scale (pass mark at 50 %, the same position as Nmin 5,0 on the Indian 10-point scale): 1 + 3 × (4,0 − 3,5) / (4,0 − 2,0) = 1,75. Equivalent to an Indian CGPA of 8,75/10 for a university with Nmin 5,0. 'soll' rule: the exam board may make exceptions (student note).

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 + Abs. 3: bachelor in EE, IT or a related field, equivalent to the TU Kaiserslautern EIT bachelor ('kein schematischer Vergleich, sondern eine Gesamtbetrachtung'); no subject credit numbers → no items (owner rule for EE equivalence).

conditional_admission.mechanism: PO § 2a: admission 'unter Auflagen' if the degree is not equivalent / lacks special requirements and the missing modules (from the TUK EIT bachelor) are at most 20 LP; more than 20 LP → not admissible (§ 2a Abs. 3). Auflagen within the first four exam periods.

descriptive_notes: RPTU programme page: 'Zulassungsbeschränkt: nein', 'Eignungsprüfung benötigt: nein'.

admission_regulation.version: PO Embedded Computing Systems vom 15.06.2021 (Verkündungsblatt 4/2021 pp. 119 ff.) — § 2 / § 2a read 18.10.2026 from text supplied by Koushik; wording identical to Automation & Control (4818). Amendments 2023/2025 per earlier reading.

accepted_degree_fields.note: Programme page (eit.rptu.de/en/esy/admission): 'a bachelor degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related area'; subject-specific entry requirements are checked and 'many impose conditions'. Distinct from EMECS (European Master in Embedded Computing Systems, own PO, expiring 30.09.2028). primary_fields reflects the GPU-R domain of this record, not regulation wording.

grade_requirement.note: PO § 2 Abs. 3: 'Das Bachelorstudium soll mit einem CGPA von mindestens 3,5 (von maximal 4,0) oder einer vergleichbaren Gesamtnote abgeschlossen worden sein.' RPTU publishes no conversion. GPU-R arithmetic (Koushik decision 18.10.2026): modified Bavarian formula with Nmin 2,0 on the 4-point scale (pass mark at 50 %, the same position as Nmin 5,0 on the Indian 10-point scale): 1 + 3 × (4,0 − 3,5) / (4,0 − 2,0) = 1,75. Equivalent to an Indian CGPA of 8,75/10 for a university with Nmin 5,0. 'soll' rule: the exam board may make exceptions (student note).

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 + Abs. 3: bachelor in EE, IT or a related field, equivalent to the TU Kaiserslautern EIT bachelor ('kein schematischer Vergleich, sondern eine Gesamtbetrachtung'); no subject credit numbers → no items (owner rule for EE equivalence).

conditional_admission.mechanism: PO § 2a: admission 'unter Auflagen' if the degree is not equivalent / lacks special requirements and the missing modules (from the TUK EIT bachelor) are at most 20 LP; more than 20 LP → not admissible (§ 2a Abs. 3). Auflagen within the first four exam periods.

descriptive_notes: RPTU master's programmes in EIT are not admission-restricted (eit.rptu.de/ac/bewerbung: 'Unsere Master-Studiengänge sind nicht zulassungsbeschränkt').

allowed_exemptions: degree from a country where English is the official language (RPTU language requirements page; programme-dependent)
language_english.note: PO § 2 Abs. 6: IELTS ≥ 6,5; TOEFL ≥ 600 paper / 250 computer / 95 iBT or equivalent; or CEFR B2; or HZB from Germany; or determination by the Prüfungsausschuss. (Old record's 95 / 6.5 confirmed; general RPTU page's 80 / 6.0 superseded.)

language_german.due: pass the RPTU A1 exam within the first year of study (exempt with a Goethe A2 certificate from abroad not older than one year)

aps_certificate.note: RPTU international 'Application & Admission' page: APS 'mandatory for the visa procedure for all Bachelor & Master Degree applicants!' with link to aps-india.de.

other_requirements: application via https://applymsc.eit.rptu.de/ for non-German Bachelor degrees (programme page)
programme taught in English, 120 ECTS, four semesters (programme page)

admission_regulation.title: Studiengangspezifische Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik der RWTH Aachen (Prüfungsordnungsversion 2027), § 3, with the Übergreifende Prüfungsordnung (ÜPO) für alle Bachelor- und Masterstudiengänge der RWTH Aachen, § 3 Abs. 6 and 9
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 2026/139 vom 06.08.2026, Prüfungsordnungsversion 2027, in force the day after publication; applies to students enrolling from summer semester 2027 (§ 16 Abs. 2) - the next intake, so stored as current (DECISION). Read ONLY in RWTH's English reference translation ('not legally binding'); the German original 2026/139 could not be located (BLOCKED). Predecessor for enrolments up to WS 2026/27: SPO vom 20.06.2024, AB 2024/072 (25.06.2024), Prüfungsordnungsversion 2024 (German read): 28/10/34/8/10/10/20 CP, maths conditions cap 11 CP, total cap 25 CP. Both versions: one admission standard for the whole programme; the five specialisations are chosen after admission (no major-specific admission annex). ÜPO: 21st version AB 2026/085 (23.06.2026, English reference translation read); 20th version AB 2026/067 not opened.

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 1: recognised first university degree under § 3 Abs. 4 ÜPO; § 3 Abs. 2: credits must be comparable in content and rigor to the RWTH Bachelor Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik (Anlage 5 maps RWTH modules to the areas). Faculty subject-requirements page: 'recognized first degree in electrical engineering, information technology, and/or technical computer science'. This record = specialisation Biomedical Systems Engineering (BMSE). The programme has five specialisations (Electrical Power Engineering (EPEN), Communications Engineering (COMM), Micro- and Nanoelectronics (MINA), Biomedical Systems Engineering (BMSE), Systems and Automation (SYAT)); all share the same admission requirements and the specialisation is chosen after admission (SPO 2027 § 4 Abs. 2: binding on the first exam registration in that specialisation's core elective catalogue). primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in SPO 2027 § 3, SPO 2024 § 3 or on the RWTH/faculty pages.

items.raw_label: SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'At least 29 CP in Higher Mathematics' (Höhere Mathematik)
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'At least 10 CP in Physics and Physical Foundations of Electrical Engineering'
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'At least 35 CP in Theoretical Foundations of Electrical Engineering, including Circuit theory'
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'At least 14 CP in Fundamentals of Computer Science and Programming'
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'At least 10 CP in Fundamentals of Systems Theory and Control Engineering'

SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'At least 5 CP in Theoretical Specializations in Electrical Engineering' (Anlage 5: electrodynamics / electromagnetic waves or theoretical foundations of high-frequency engineering)

SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'At least 25 CP in application-oriented coursework in the following areas: Circuit Design, Microelectronics, Communications Engineering, Power Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Biomedical Engineering'

subject_credit_requirements.note: Area totals exactly as SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2 (English translation; German original BLOCKED). Anlage 5 lists the RWTH Bachelor modules per area as the comparability reference (not separate requirements; rule R7: not split). Category mapping is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): item 5 'Systems Theory and Control Engineering' = control_systems + signals_systems (POOLED); item 6 'Theoretical Specializations' -> electromagnetic_field_theory because Anlage 5 lists only electrodynamics/EM waves and HF-theory modules (DECISION); item 7 pool encodes the six named areas (POOLED). TAXONOMY GAP (counts 0 until taxonomy phase): signals_systems, electromagnetic_field_theory, electronics, microelectronics_semiconductors, power_engineering, computer_engineering, engineering.biomedical_engineering. Item 6 therefore counts 0 for every applicant until the taxonomy phase. Previous version (SPO 2024, AB 2024/072, still shown on the faculty subject-requirements page): Höhere Mathematik 28, Physik 10, Theoretische Grundlagen der ET inkl. Schaltungstechnik 34, Grundlagen der Informatik und Programmierung 8, Grundlagen der Systemtheorie 10, Theoretische Vertiefungen in ET oder IT 10, anwendungsorientierte Veranstaltungen 20 (CONFLICT note: page = 2024 values). Koushik decisions 21.10.2026 (add-up rule): (1) item 3 'Theoretical Foundations of Electrical Engineering, including Circuit theory' = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory + signals_systems (RWTH counts signals & systems under the foundations) — not general_ee, which counts ALL EE subjects; (2) signals_systems stays in item 5 as well (overlap allowed, D13 removed); (3) application pool: power_electronics + electrical_machines_drives added under 'Power Engineering'. Item 4 'Fundamentals of Computer Science and Programming' = general_cs alone (Koushik rule 21.10.2026: general_cs counts all CS subjects incl. programming). Verified 21.10.2026 against the 2027 English reference version (AB 2026/139, full text supplied by Koushik): § 3 (2) values 29/10/35/14/10/5/25 confirmed. Appendix 5: Physics area = Physics 1 + Physics 2 only (general_physics correct); Foundations 35 = Fundamentals of EE 1 (circuit analysis), 2 (components and circuits), 3 (signals and systems), 4 (electromagnetic fields) + Circuit Design 1 → circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory + signals_systems + electronics (add-up); CS and programming 14 = programming/algorithms/data structures, principles of digital computers, AI in robotics (general_cs); application pool reference modules include Communication Networks → computer_networks added (TAXONOMY GAP).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 3 with § 3 Abs. 6 ÜPO): conditional admission granted under ÜPO § 3(6), but denied if more than 12 CP of additional higher-mathematics coursework would be needed or if total additional coursework across all areas exceeds 25 CP. Per-area cap: Höhere Mathematik max. 12 CP (stored total 25 per engine rule E8; engine must also check the maths cap). ÜPO § 3(6): requirements only from RWTH Bachelor modules, proof 'prior to registration for the Master's thesis'. (SPO 2024: maths 11 CP, total 25 CP.)

descriptive_notes: The faculty examination board checks subject suitability ('Überprüfung der fachlichen Eignung') against the comparability list (Anlage 5); rejection if requirements are not met in all areas or 'in Kernbereichen eklatant nicht erfüllt' (faculty admission page).
Open admission: no NC, no limited number of places (RWTH programme description 'Open (No NC)'; faculty page: 'zugangsbeschränkt' only in the sense of required qualifications).
Specialisation (BMSE) is chosen after admission; requirements are identical for all five specialisations.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or English-taught degree obtained in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Canada or the United States (ÜPO § 3 Abs. 9 with Abs. 8)
university-qualification English test passed under the Feststellungsprüfungsordnung Hochschule (ÜPO § 3 Abs. 8/9)
language_english.note: SPO § 3 Abs. 4: English per § 3 Abs. 9 ÜPO. ÜPO (21st version, AB 2026/085 of 23.06.2026, English reference translation read): B2; TOEFL iBT 'minimum score of 90 points' (or 4.5 on the 1-6 scale); IELTS 'minimum score of 6.0'; PTE Academic 'minimum score of 60 points'; Cambridge B2 First grade B or higher, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency; UNIcert II; school certificate of a Council of Europe state confirming B2; RWTH placement test B2.2.1 only for enrolled students. MOI is not listed among the accepted proofs (not addressed explicitly -> null). RWTH programme description: proof of English 'at enrollment'.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: all applicants except citizens of an EU/EEA member state and Bildungsinländer (SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test at the time of application: Quantitative Reasoning in the top 15% of the test year (above the 85th percentile); Verbal Reasoning in the top 85% (above the 15th percentile). Scores sent by ETS to RWTH (institution code 8504).

other_requirements: Application via RWTHonline; GRE scores must be reported by ETS to RWTH (institution code 8504)

During the programme: at least two RWTH Language Center German modules unless German native speaker, German-language school/first degree, or B1 or higher at start (SPO 2027 Anlage 1) - not an admission requirement
18-week industrial internship is part of the curriculum (not an admission requirement)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 March (open-admission master's programmes, non-EU/EEA applicants without German degree; RWTH international applicants page and faculty application page)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 September (same pages)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Area totals exactly as SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2 (English translation; German original BLOCKED). Anlage 5 lists the RWTH Bachelor modules per area as the comparability reference (not separate requirements; rule R7: not split). Category mapping is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): item 5 'Systems Theory and Control Engineering' = control_systems + signals_systems (POOLED); item 6 'Theoretical Specializations' -> electromagnetic_field_theory because Anlage 5 lists only electrodynamics/EM waves and HF-theory modules (DECISION); item 7 pool encodes the six named areas (POOLED). TAXONOMY GAP (counts 0 until taxonomy phase): signals_systems, electromagnetic_field_theory, electronics, microelectronics_semiconductors, power_engineering, computer_engineering, engineering.biomedical_engineering. Item 6 therefore counts 0 for every applicant until the taxonomy phase. Previous version (SPO 2024, AB 2024/072, still shown on the faculty subject-requirements page): Höhere Mathematik 28, Physik 10, Theoretische Grundlagen der ET inkl. Schaltungstechnik 34, Grundlagen der Informatik und Programmierung 8, Grundlagen der Systemtheorie 10, Theoretische Vertiefungen in ET oder IT 10, anwendungsorientierte Veranstaltungen 20 (CONFLICT note: page = 2024 values). Koushik decisions 21.10.2026 (add-up rule): (1) item 3 'Theoretical Foundations of Electrical Engineering, including Circuit theory' = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory + signals_systems (RWTH counts signals & systems under the foundations) — not general_ee, which counts ALL EE subjects; (2) signals_systems stays in item 5 as well (overlap allowed, D13 removed); (3) application pool: power_electronics + electrical_machines_drives added under 'Power Engineering'. Item 4 'Fundamentals of Computer Science and Programming' = general_cs alone (Koushik rule 21.10.2026: general_cs counts all CS subjects incl. programming). Verified 21.10.2026 against the 2027 English reference version (AB 2026/139, full text supplied by Koushik): § 3 (2) values 29/10/35/14/10/5/25 confirmed. conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 3 with § 3 Abs. 6 ÜPO): conditional admission granted under ÜPO § 3(6), but denied if more than 12 CP of additional higher-mathematics coursework would be needed or if total additional coursework across all areas exceeds 25 CP. ÜPO § 3(6): requirements only from RWTH Bachelor modules, proof 'prior to registration for the Master's thesis'. (SPO 2024: maths 11 CP, total 25 CP.)

descriptive_notes: The faculty examination board checks subject suitability ('Überprüfung der fachlichen Eignung') against the comparability list (Anlage 5); rejection if requirements are not met in all areas or 'in Kernbereichen eklatant nicht erfüllt' (faculty admission page).
Open admission: no NC, no limited number of places (RWTH programme description 'Open (No NC)'; faculty page: 'zugangsbeschränkt' only in the sense of required qualifications).

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or English-taught degree obtained in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Canada or the United States (ÜPO § 3 Abs. 9 with Abs. 8)
university-qualification English test passed under the Feststellungsprüfungsordnung Hochschule (ÜPO § 3 Abs. 8/9)
language_english.note: SPO § 3 Abs. 4: English per § 3 Abs. 9 ÜPO. MOI is not listed among the accepted proofs (not addressed explicitly -> null). RWTH programme description: proof of English 'at enrollment'.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: all applicants except citizens of an EU/EEA member state and Bildungsinländer (SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test at the time of application: Quantitative Reasoning in the top 15% of the test year (above the 85th percentile); Verbal Reasoning in the top 85% (above the 15th percentile). Scores sent by ETS to RWTH (institution code 8504).

other_requirements: Application via RWTHonline; GRE scores must be reported by ETS to RWTH (institution code 8504)

During the programme: at least two RWTH Language Center German modules unless German native speaker, German-language school/first degree, or B1 or higher at start (SPO 2027 Anlage 1) - not an admission requirement
18-week industrial internship is part of the curriculum (not an admission requirement)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 September (same pages)

admission_regulation.title: Studiengangspezifische Prüfungsordnung für den Masterstudiengang Computer Engineering der RWTH Aachen (Prüfungsordnungsversion 2027), § 3 and Anlage 5, with the Übergreifende Prüfungsordnung (ÜPO), § 3 Abs. 6 and 9
admission_regulation.version: Amtliche Bekanntmachung Nr. 2026/140 vom 06.08.2026 (SPO vom 05.08.2026), Prüfungsordnungsversion 2027 (German original read), in force the day after publication; applies to students enrolling from summer semester 2027 (§ 16 Abs. 2) - the next intake, so stored as current (DECISION). Students enrolled earlier may stay on the SPO vom 20.06.2024 until 30.09.2029. Predecessor: AB 2024/071 (25.06.2024), Prüfungsordnungsversion 2024 (English translation read): 25/5/23/16/10/10/20 CP, maths conditions cap 8 CP, total cap 25 CP. ÜPO: 21st version AB 2026/085 (23.06.2026, English reference translation read).

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 1: 'Zugangsvoraussetzung ist ein anerkannter erster Hochschulabschluss gemäß § 3 Abs. 4 ÜPO.' § 3 Abs. 2: achievements must be comparable to the RWTH B.Sc. Computer Engineering (content mapping per Anlage 5). Faculty subject-requirements page: 'recognized first university degree in electrical engineering, information technology and/or computer engineering'. Computer Engineering was formerly a major (COMP) of the expiring combined M.Sc. Electrical Engineering, Information Technology and Computer Engineering; it is now a separate M.Sc. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade in SPO 2027 § 3, SPO 2024 § 3 or on the RWTH/faculty pages.

items.raw_label: SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'Mindestens 27 CP aus dem Bereich Höhere Mathematik'
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'Mindestens 5 CP aus dem Bereich Physik und physikalische Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik'
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'Mindestens 24 CP aus dem Bereich Theoretische Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik'
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'Mindestens 22 CP aus dem Bereich Grundlagen der Informatik und Programmierung'
SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'Mindestens 10 CP aus dem Bereich Grundlagen der Systemtheorie und Regelungstechnik'

SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'Mindestens 10 CP aus dem Bereich Theoretische Vertiefungen in Informationstechnik' (Anlage 5: Stochastische Modellierung in den Ingenieurwissenschaften 5; Informationstheoretisches und probabilistisches maschinelles Lernen 5)

SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2: 'Mindestens 20 CP aus anwendungsorientierten Veranstaltungen' (Schaltungstechnik, Mikroelektronik, Kommunikationstechnik, Energietechnik, Informatik, Technische Informatik oder Medizintechnik)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Area totals exactly as SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 2 (German). Anlage 5 lists RWTH B.Sc. Computer Engineering modules per area as comparability reference (not separate requirements; rule R7: not split). Category mapping is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): item 5 = control_systems + signals_systems (POOLED); item 6 'Theoretische Vertiefungen in Informationstechnik' -> proposed electrical_electronic_engineering.information_theory (Anlage 5: stochastic modelling, information-theoretic/probabilistic ML; faculty page under PO 2024: 'Electromagnetic Field Theory or Theoretical Information Theory') - kept out of communications so it does not share a category with item 7 (DECISION); TAXONOMY GAP (counts 0 until taxonomy phase): signals_systems, information_theory, electronics, microelectronics_semiconductors, power_engineering, computer_engineering, engineering.biomedical_engineering; item 6 counts 0 for every applicant until then. Previous version (SPO 2024, AB 2024/071; still shown on the faculty subject-requirements page): Höhere Mathematik 25, Physik 5, Theoretische Grundlagen der ET 23, Informatik und Programmierung 16, Systemtheorie 10, Theoretische Vertiefungen in ET oder IT 10, anwendungsorientiert 20 (CONFLICT note). Koushik decisions 21.10.2026 (add-up rule; checked against the German original AB 2026/140, values 27/5/24/22/10/10/20 and Auflagen max. 9 maths / 25 total confirmed): item 3 'Theoretische Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik' = circuit_theory + signals_systems (Anlage 5: Grundgebiete der ET 1 Schaltungsanalyse, 2 Komponenten und Schaltungen, 3 Signale und Systeme) — not general_ee, which counts ALL EE subjects; item 4 = general_cs alone (all CS subjects incl. programming); item 6 = information_theory + statistics_probability (stochastic modelling) + machine_learning_ai (probabilistic ML); item 7 pool also covers 'Informatik' (general_cs — D13 removed, overlap allowed) and Anlage 5 modules power electronics (power_electronics), Kommunikationsnetze (computer_networks), Grundgebiete der ET 4 / Elektrodynamik (electromagnetic_field_theory). Physics 5 = Physik 1 only (general_physics).

conditional_admission.mechanism: Auflagen (SPO 2027 § 3 Abs. 3 with § 3 Abs. 6 ÜPO): 'Eine Zulassung zum Masterstudiengang ist nicht möglich, wenn' im Bereich Höhere Mathematik 'Auflagen von mehr als 9 CP erforderlich wären' oder die Auflagen insgesamt 25 CP überschreiten. Per-area cap: Höhere Mathematik max. 9 CP (stored total 25 per engine rule E8; engine must also check the maths cap). ÜPO § 3(6): only RWTH Bachelor modules, proof before registering the Master's thesis. (SPO 2024: maths 8 CP, total 25 CP.)

descriptive_notes: The examination board checks comparability with the RWTH B.Sc. Computer Engineering (Anlage 5) and decides on conditions (SPO § 3 Abs. 2-3; ÜPO § 3 Abs. 6 and 12).
Open admission (no NC) per RWTH programme description.

allowed_exemptions: university entrance qualification or English-taught degree obtained in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Canada or the United States (ÜPO § 3 Abs. 9 with Abs. 8)
university-qualification English test passed under the Feststellungsprüfungsordnung Hochschule (ÜPO § 3 Abs. 8/9)
language_english.note: SPO § 3 Abs. 4: English per § 3 Abs. 9 ÜPO. ÜPO (21st version, AB 2026/085 of 23.06.2026, English reference translation read): B2; TOEFL iBT 'minimum score of 90 points' (or 4.5 on the 1-6 scale); IELTS 'minimum score of 6.0'; PTE Academic 'minimum score of 60 points'; Cambridge B2 First grade B or higher, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency; UNIcert II; school certificate of a Council of Europe state confirming B2; RWTH placement test B2.2.1 only for enrolled students. admission_regulation.title: Fachspezifische Bestimmungen für den Bachelor-Studiengang Eingebettete Systeme und den Master-Studiengang Embedded Systems der Universität des Saarlandes (§ 33 Zugang zum Master-Studium), with the Gemeinsame Prüfungsordnung für die Bachelor- und Master-Studiengänge der Fakultät für Mathematik und Informatik an der Universität des Saarlandes (§ 12)
admission_regulation.version: FSB vom 2. Juni 2016, Dienstblatt Nr. 67, ausgegeben 07.10.2016 (Dienstbl. 2016 S. 642); the faculty regulations page lists no amendment or newer FSB for Embedded Systems (checked 17.10.2026; site search for 2025/2026 Dienstblatt amendments found none). GPO vom 25.02.2021 (Dienstbl. 2021 S. 580), no amendment listed. Programme page links the same three documents.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FSB § 33 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: Bachelor 'wer an einer deutschen Hochschule einen Bachelor-Abschluss oder an einer ausländischen Hochschule' einen äquivalenten Abschluss in 'Ingenieurinformatik, Eingebettete Systeme, Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder einem verwandten Fach'; Nr. 2: proof of 'besondere Eignung' (§ 69 Abs. 5 UG). Programme page: Bachelor in engineering informatics, embedded systems, informatics/computer science, electrical engineering, mechatronics or a related discipline. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: Koushik decision 19.10.2026 (applied to all Saarland Informatics Campus programmes): store the official application-guide minimum as a hard grade — GPU-R policy (official university page, not regulation wording; the FSB set no limit). SIC Application Guide (Embedded Systems block) (page modified 02.10.2026, https://saarland-informatics-campus.de/en/studium-studies/master-english/application-guide/): 'Minimal prerequisite is a cumulative undergraduate grade point average (CGPA) of 75% or 3.00 GPA on a 4 point scale and ranking in the top 10% of the graduating class.' Cross-checked 19.10.2026 on MyGermanUniversity and Expatrio StudyBuddy (third-party; both state 75 %, most also the top-10 % ranking). GPU-R conversion: 3,00/4 with Nmin 2,0 → 2,5; 75 % read as CGPA 7,5/10 with Indian Nmin 5,0 → 1 + 3 × (10 − 7,5)/5 = 2,5. The top-10 % ranking cannot be checked (student note).

items.raw_label: FSB § 33 Abs. 2 lit. b I. 'Mathematik (diskrete Mathematik, ein- und mehrdimensionale Analysis, Lineare Algebra, Numerik, Stochastik)'
FSB § 33 Abs. 2 lit. b II. 'Informatik (funktionale und objektorientierte Programmierung, Methoden der Softwareentwicklung, formale Methoden)'
FSB § 33 Abs. 2 lit. b III. 'Engineering (Elektrotechnik, Eingebettete Systeme, Signal-, System- und Informationstheorie)'

subject_credit_requirements.note: FSB § 33 Abs. 2 lit. b names three competence areas with topic lists and no CP numbers -> presence-only, one pooled item per area (owner rule; same treatment as Saarland 4758). Mapping GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): Numerik and Stochastik are inside general_mathematics; 'Eingebettete Systeme' is covered by general_ee (eee taxonomy includes microprocessors/embedded); 'Signal-, System- und Informationstheorie' -> signals_systems (TAXONOMY GAP, counts 0) + communications (information theory). Programme page wording: 'mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, numerical methods, stochastics), informatics (e.g., functional and object-oriented programming, formal methods), and engineering (e.g., signal processing, systems theory)' - the binding FSB lists are not introduced by 'z. B.'. Koushik decisions 21.10.2026: Informatik area = general_cs alone (all CS subjects); Engineering area = general_ee (Elektrotechnik) + signals_systems (Signal-/Systemtheorie) + computer_engineering (Eingebettete Systeme) + information_theory (Informationstheorie), replacing communications. Add-up rule; presence-only.

conditional_admission.mechanism: Vorläufige Zulassung unter der Bedingung (GPO § 12 Abs. 5): 'Sind die in Absatz 4 genannten Voraussetzungen nicht gegeben, kann der oder die Studierende vorläufig zum entsprechenden Master-Studium unter der Bedingung zugelassen werden, dass die festgestellten fehlenden Inhalte - soweit in den Fachspezifischen Bestimmungen nicht anderes geregelt maximal im Umfang von 30 CP - im Rahmen eines ergänzenden Studiums innerhalb einer festgelegten Frist nachgeholt werden.' FSB § 33 contains no different rule. Koushik decision 21.10.2026: aligned with approved Saarland CS 3624 (allowed, 30) because the FSB name content areas.

descriptive_notes: Besondere Eignung (FSB § 33 Abs. 2): English, academic record and content of the bachelor's degree, and study interest documented 'in Form eines Dossiers und zweier qualifizierender Gutachten'; 'Die Feststellung, ob die Zugangsvoraussetzungen erfüllt sind, trifft der Prüfungsausschuss.'
SIC application guide (not in the FSB): minimal prerequisite CGPA 75% or 3.00/4 and top 10% of the graduating class; meeting the minimum 'does not guarantee your admission'.

allowed_exemptions: native speakers from Australia, Ireland, Canada, New Zealand, the UK and the USA (SIC application guide)
in-person studies at a university in one of these countries while physically residing there (SIC application guide)
language_english.note: FSB § 33 Abs. 2 lit. a: 'Nachweis englischer Sprachkenntnisse auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau (in der Regel C1)' - 'in der Regel': the stored C1 hard check is GPU-R policy (not regulation wording). Scores from the SIC application guide: IELTS (academic) min. 7.0; TOEFL iBT min. 95 ('2026: 5 out of 6'); TOEFL paper min. 600; Cambridge CAE or CPE; PTE Academic min. 76; home editions and expired tests accepted. 'A confirmation of your university or a MOI (Medium of Instruction) is not a sufficient equivalent.' Programme page: MOI certificates are not accepted.

standardized_test_requirements.required_for: applicants without a degree from the EHEA, Switzerland or the UK (SIC application guide; not in FSB/GPO)
standardized_test_requirements.details: GRE General Test or Indian GATE; no minimum score; home editions accepted; subject/prep tests do not count; no exception for non-EHEA branch campuses.

aps_certificate.note: SIC application guide: original digitally signed APS certificate required for applicants with a university degree from China, India or Vietnam.

other_requirements: Two complete review forms filled out by recommenders in the online application system (SIC guide; FSB: 'zweier qualifizierender Gutachten'); letters by mail not accepted
Dossier / personal statement documenting study interest (FSB § 33 Abs. 2 lit. c; programme page 'personal statement')
CV incl. research interests, projects, publications; certified course/grade list with grading system; copies of the 3 most recent degrees (SIC guide)
Application via the SIC online portal

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 November (late deadline; early deadline 15 May; programme page and SIC guide)

admission_regulation.title: Prüfungsordnung für den Master-Studiengang Systems Engineering (§ 17 Zugangsvoraussetzungen)
admission_regulation.version: vom 23. April 2015, Dienstblatt Nr. 67 (30.09.2015), S. 526; Änderungsordnung Dienstbl. 2016 S. 474 (listed on the NT-faculty regulations page without a PDF link; not opened separately - the WebFetch summary of the 2015 PDF names an 'Ordnung vom 7. Juli 2016, Dienstblatt Nr. 56' that does not change § 17; checked: the 2016 amendment concerns only the double-degree option, admission § 17 unchanged). No 2017-2026 PO or amendment listed on the regulations page (checked 17.10.2026). Official English translation (reflects the 2015 version, information only) read as cross-check.

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO § 17 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: Bachelor or equivalent 'in einem Studiengang des Systems Engineering oder einem verwandten Fach', 'insbesondere aus den Gebieten Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik, Mikrosystemtechnik oder Mechatronik'; Nr. 3: 'besondere Eignung (§ 69 Abs. 5 UG)'. Abs. 2: aptitude compared 'mit dem Profil und den Anforderungen des Master-Studiengangs Systems Engineering und dessen Vertiefungen'. ROUTE A (this record): PO § 17 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 - Bachelor overall grade 'von „gut“ (2,5) oder besser'. Other route (9723_B): Nr. 2 - qualifying references or an oral hearing before two examiners of the Fachrichtung Mechatronik, 'unter maßgeblicher Berücksichtigung der Gesamtnote' (no numeric limit). primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording).

grade_requirement.note: PO § 17 Abs. 2 Nr. 1: Gesamtnote 'von „gut“ (2,5) oder besser'. Programme page: 'at least "good" (German scale: 2.5)'. No conversion method stated.

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO § 17 names no subject areas or credit amounts; only a degree in Systems Engineering or a related field and aptitude matched to the programme profile and its specialisations. Faculty page: admission based on the last degree being equivalent to a relevant Saarland University bachelor's degree; module descriptions are part of the application (exam board check).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No rule allowing missing subjects/modules to be made up in PO § 17. § 17 Abs. 3 only allows provisional admission before the Bachelor certificate is available (certificate 'binnen einer vom Prüfungsausschuss individuell festzulegenden Frist') - not a content condition.

descriptive_notes: Applicants with an overall grade worse than 2.5 can qualify via route 9723_B (qualifying references or oral hearing before two examiners of the Fachrichtung Mechatronik, with significant weight on the overall grade).

Specialisations: Produktionssysteme, Systems Design, Sensor-Aktor-Systeme, Integrierte Systeme, Sustainable Engineering (German); Information & Communication Systems and Robotic Systems (English) (faculty page).

allowed_exemptions: German Abitur with at least six years of English classes (faculty page)
language_english.note: PO § 17 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'ausreichende Sprachkenntnisse (in der Regel Stufe B2 gemäß europäischem Referenzrahmen bzw. vergleichbar oder besser)' 'für das Fachstudium in Deutsch und/oder Englisch'. Stored for the English-taught specialisations (Information & Communication Systems, Robotic Systems) as the EEE-relevant track (DECISION); German-taught specialisations need German B2 instead. No test scores stated in the PO or on the pages. Faculty page: without proof, conditional provisional admission is possible with proof of the level within one semester (page only, not in § 17). No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (MyGU 24.10.2026: B2; provisional admission possible if B2 is shown within one semester).

other_requirements: Motivation letter ('Purpose of Study'), short course descriptions / module handbook excerpt, certified transcript, copies of degrees, explanation of the home grading system, certified translations if not in English (faculty page)
Online application via the Saarland University SIM portal
Provisional admission before the Bachelor certificate possible; certificate within a deadline set by the examination board (PO § 17 Abs. 3)
Applicants needing a visa should apply by 15 January (winter) / 15 July (summer) (faculty page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 1 September (application window mid-June to 1 September; visa applicants recommended by 15 January)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 1 March (application window mid-December to 1 March; visa applicants recommended by 15 July)

accepted_degree_fields.note: PO Teil II § 2 Abs. 1: first degree with a standard period of 7 semesters (210 CP) in 'General Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering and Computer Networks, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology or Computer Engineering', or a related programme that 'must contain electrical engineering and information technology components to a similar extent as the Bachelor's degree programme in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology at the Technische Hochschule Mittelhessen' — the Admissions Committee decides. 6-semester (180 CP) degrees: § 4 Abs. 6. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy).

grade_requirement.note: PO Teil II § 2 Abs. 2: overall grade 'at least ‘good’ (at least 72.5 percentage points in accordance with § 9 para. 2 of Part I …; 2.5)'. No conversion method for foreign grades stated.

subject_credit_requirements.note: PO Teil II § 2 sets no subject credit numbers; related degrees need EE/IT components similar to THM's EE&IT bachelor (Admissions Committee) — no items (owner rule for EE equivalence).

conditional_admission.mechanism: PO Teil II § 4 Abs. 5: applicants lacking knowledge and skills needed in the master's modules 'may be admitted … subject to certain conditions'; missing content is made up through THM bachelor modules (esp. EE&IT), set by the Admissions Committee; 'No more knowledge and competences may be missing than can be made up within the framework of 30 CrP'; proof by the end of the 3rd semester. Programme-level rule with cap 30. Separately, § 4 Abs. 6: 180-CP bachelors are admitted with 30 CP of additional modules (total-credit top-up, by end of 3rd semester).

descriptive_notes: The Admission Board (three professors) decides on all subject-specific requirements and may request further documents (PO Teil II § 4 Abs. 2).
Applicants with a foreign bachelor apply via uni-assist (DAAD listing).

PO § 4 Abs. 4 (Version 7, in force 01.12.2025): the admission commission assigns each applicant, based on prior knowledge, to one of the specialisations Control, Computer or Communications Engineering, or to no specialisation; with several options the preference in the motivation letter decides. Admission is 'mit der Auflage', to study in the assigned specialisation; one change only in justified exceptions.
Anlage 1: the commission also decides whether the student takes 'English in a Professional Environment' or 'German as a Foreign Language' (4 CrP each) — based on prior knowledge.

language_english.note: PO Teil II § 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 4: English 'at level B2 …, usually proven by the Cambridge First Certificate, a TOEFL test, a TOEIC test or an IELTS test'; the Admissions Committee decides on recognition. other_requirements: Personal and professional background (CV) in English and a motivation letter in English stating the preferred specialisation (PO Teil II § 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 2–3)

admission_regulation.title: Besondere Ordnung über den Zugang und die Zulassung für den konsekutiven Masterstudiengang „Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik“ der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Physik (with the Allgemeine Zugangs- und Zulassungsordnung für Masterstudiengänge, Allg. ZO-MA)
admission_regulation.version: Neufassung, hochschulöffentliche Bekanntmachung vom 05.03.2025 (TU-Verkündungsblatt Nr. 1630), geändert durch 1. Änderungsordnung (Verkündungsblatt Nr. 1664; Fakultätsratsbeschluss 14.07.2025; in force 01.10.2025, first applied to admissions for Sommersemester 2026). Read in the official Lesefassung (Stand 30.09.2025) and the unofficial English translation 'Admissions Regulations PO 5' (states it translates 'the German version date 2 March 2026'; no German document of that date is listed on the regulations page — see DECISION). The amendment and Neufassung PDFs themselves were not opened (Lesefassung used).

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZO § 2 Abs. 1: Bachelor (or equivalent) in Elektrotechnik / Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik or a fachlich geeigneter Studiengang (Abs. 2) from a German or Bologna-signatory university or an equivalent foreign degree (anabin). § 2 Abs. 2: the Auswahlkommission decides on suitability; a programme 'gilt in der Regel als fachlich geeignet' if there are 'keine wesentlichen Unterschiede' to the TU Braunschweig bachelor and at least 60 LP are shown in the two areas of Anlage 1 Ziffer 1, each at its minimum. Microelectronics Engineering is the English-language track of the M.Sc. Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik (programme page: 'is part of the Master's degree programme "Electrical Engineering"'); the degree is the M.Sc. EIT. The programme can be studied in German or English (§ 2 Abs. 5).

grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade. The grade is used only for ranking if admission is restricted: P = 10*(4-grade)+35 (§ 4).

items.raw_label: Anlage 1 Ziffer 1: Mathematik und physikalische Grundlagen, min. 15 LP (gewöhnliche Differentialgleichungen, Differential- und Integralrechnung in mehreren reellen und komplexen Variablen, lineare Algebra und analytische Geometrie, Statistik und Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie; Mechanik, Thermodynamik, Optik, Atomphysik)

Anlage 1 Ziffer 1: Grundlagen und Kernbereiche der Elektro- und Informationstechnik, min. 45 LP (Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik, Netzwerktheorie, Werkstoffe der Elektrotechnik, Messtechnik, Leitungstheorie, elektromagnetische Feldtheorie, Grundlagen der Elektronik, Grundlagen der Energietechnik, CMOS-Schaltungen, Grundlagen der Nachrichten-/Hochfrequenztechnik, Grundlagen der Regelungstechnik, Programmierung, vertiefte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem einschlägigen elektrotechnischen Wahlbereich)
Anlage 1 Ziffer 2: Grundlagen der Elektronik, mindestens 5 LP (if missing: Nebenbestimmung, § 2 Abs. 3)
Anlage 1 Ziffer 2: Grundlagen der elektrischen Energietechnik, mindestens 5 LP (if missing: Nebenbestimmung)
Anlage 1 Ziffer 2: Grundlagen der Informationstechnik, mindestens 5 LP (if missing: Nebenbestimmung)
Anlage 1 Ziffer 2: Grundlagen der Regelungstechnik, mindestens 5 LP (if missing: Nebenbestimmung)

subject_credit_requirements.note: § 2 Abs. 1 b requires the Anlage 1 knowledge 'im dort geforderten Umfang'. Item 1 is one 15-LP pool (maths + physics, POOLED). Item 2 is the 45-LP area; the four Ziffer-2 subjects (each 'jeweils mindestens 5 LP') lie inside it (NESTED). 'Grundlagen der Informationstechnik' mapped to communications (GPU-R policy, not regulation wording: at TU Braunschweig the area covers communications/RF basics). TAXONOMY GAP (counts 0 until taxonomy phase): electronics, power_engineering (items 3-4). The § 4 ranking awards 'technical knowledge' points (1 point per maths/physics area, 2 per EE area with at least 2 credits; max 29) — selection only. Koushik rules 20./21.10.2026 applied: item 2 '45 LP Grundlagen und Kernbereiche der Elektro- und Informationstechnik' = general_ee (counts ALL EE subjects, incl. electronics, energy, information and control technology — overlap with items 3–6 allowed, D13 removed) + programming_practical_cs ('Programmierung', a CS subject); EE sub-categories removed as redundant. Re-verified 21.10.2026 against the 1st amendment (Lesefassung, in force 01.10.2025, first for SS 2026) and its English translation of 02.03.2026: 15 / 45 LP, 5 LP each in Ziffer 2, § 2 Abs. 2 'at least 60 LP in total', English TOEFL iBT 88 / IELTS 6.5 (not older than 3 years), deadlines 15 July / 15 January — all match.

conditional_admission.mechanism: ZO § 2 Abs. 3: if Anlage 1 Ziffer 2 knowledge (Grundlagen der Elektronik, der elektrischen Energietechnik, der Informationstechnik, der Regelungstechnik; 'nicht im Umfang von jeweils mindestens 5 LP') is missing, admission 'kann mit der Nebenbestimmung versehen werden, diese innerhalb von zwei Fachsemestern nach Studienbeginn nachzuholen'. No LP cap stated for first-semester admission (owner rule: max_ects null). GPU-R arithmetic: at most 4 x 5 = 20 LP can be missing under this rule; it applies only to the Ziffer-2 items, not to the 15/45-LP areas (DECISION). § 7 Abs. 2 (higher semesters only): up to 16 LP until thesis registration.

admission_regulation.version: TU-Verkündungsblatt Nr. 1672 vom 08.12.2025 (Fakultätsrat 20.10.2025); in force 01.01.2026, first governs admissions for Wintersemester 2026/27; the previous ZO (vorläufige ZO 15.11.2023) expires after the Sommersemester 2026 procedure. accepted_degree_fields.note: ZO § 2 Abs. 1: Bachelor or equivalent with a natural-science/engineering focus in Elektrotechnik / Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik, Physik, Informatik or another relevant subject (German, Bologna or anabin-equivalent foreign degree), plus the Anlage 1 knowledge 'im dort geforderten Umfang'. § 2 Abs. 2: suitable if no significant differences to the TU Braunschweig B.Sc. grade_requirement.note: No minimum grade; the final (or average) grade is used only for ranking if oversubscribed (§ 4).

items.raw_label: Anlage 1 Ziffer 1: Mathematik und physikalische Grundlagen, min. 15 LP (gewöhnliche Differentialgleichungen, Differential- und Integralrechnung in mehreren reellen und komplexen Variablen, lineare Algebra und analytische Geometrie, Statistik und Wahrscheinlichkeitstheorie; Mechanik, Thermodynamik, Optik, Atomphysik)

Anlage 1: Grundlagen und Kernbereiche der Elektro- und Informationstechnik, min. 45 LP (Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik, Netzwerke, Werkstoffe der Elektrotechnik, Messtechnik, Leitungstheorie, elektromagnetische Feldtheorie, Grundlagen der Elektronik, Grundlagen der Energietechnik, Schaltungstechnik, Grundlagen der Informationstechnik, Grundlagen der Regelungstechnik, Programmierung, vertiefte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem einschlägigen elektrotechnischen Wahlbereich)

subject_credit_requirements.note: Two pooled areas with one LP number each (POOLED); the topic lists have no own numbers, so they are covered categories of one item each (owner rule). admission_regulation.version: Verkündungsblatt Nr. 211/2021 (approved by the President 05.05.2021), applies to students enrolled from WS 2021/22. German PDF re-read 21.10.2026 (Anlage Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen); content read from TU Ilmenau's English translations (PS-2021-CSP-M-ER-STR-SP.pdf and M-ER-STR-SP-CSP-2021.pdf). The aptitude-test page still lists the 2021 version as current (18.10.2026). No 2024-2026 amendment found by site search (Verkündungsblatt 269/2024 and 276/2025 surfaced but not opened). German binding text located by independent checker 18.10.2026 (BLOCKED cleared). 1st amendment Verkündungsblatt Nr. 280 of 04.02.2026 (from SS 2026; double degree with Lorraine; no admission change). 1st amendment (Verkündungsblatt Nr. 280/2026 of 04.02.2026, for students from SS 2026) read 21.10.2026: replaces only the Profilbeschreibung and adds a double-degree annex (Université de Lorraine) — no change to admission.

accepted_degree_fields.note: ZugO § 3(2): first degree with at least 180 ECTS. Annex item 4 (aptitude test points for the first degree): 40 points for Electrical Engineering and Information Technology (ICT focus) or Computer and Systems Engineering (Telecommunications and Measurement focus) with in-depth knowledge of the item-3 fields; 30 points for listed EE&IT, Media Technology and Computer and Systems Engineering majors without that depth; 20 points for other engineering or natural science programmes. Programme page: 'Abschluss eines verwandten Bachelorstudiums'.

grade_requirement.note: No grade limit. The final grade gives aptitude-test points (item 5/8): 'very good = 30 points', 'good = 20 points', 'satisfactory = 10 points'.

subject_credit_requirements.note: Koushik decision 21.10.2026: the Anlage lists the knowledge fields the degree 'should' cover (Ziffer 3) but attaches no points and no pass/fail rule to them — the only gate is the 70-point aptitude test (degree field, grade, extra points). Presence checks would wrongly fail students, so the fields are stored as information only (no items). Expected prior knowledge: Annex item 3: technical mathematics and Fourier analysis; Annex item 3: linear algebra; Annex item 3: statistics and probability; Annex item 3: programming and numerical methods; Annex item 3: digital signal processing; Annex item 3: signals, systems and communications; Annex item 3: information theory and coding.

conditional_admission.mechanism: No programme-level rule in the Special Provisions annex. University-wide Ordnung für den Zugang zu Masterstudiengängen (ZugO/MAZugO, VB 183/2020, 1st amendment VB 192/2021) § 4(4)-(6): requirements met also with a positive prognosis that missing qualifications can be obtained; additional requirements of up to 30 ECTS may be set ('admission ... only permitted subject to conditions'); more than 30 ECTS missing = not met; up to 60 ECTS possible via a preparatory course if the department offers one. University-wide rule alone → false (owner rule) — DECISION.

descriptive_notes: Expected prior knowledge (Anlage Ziffer 3, information only — assessed by the examination board within the 70-point test): Annex item 3: technical mathematics and Fourier analysis; Annex item 3: linear algebra; Annex item 3: statistics and probability; Annex item 3: programming and numerical methods; Annex item 3: digital signal processing; Annex item 3: signals, systems and communications; Annex item 3: information theory and coding.

Aptitude test (Eignungsfeststellung, ZugO § 4) on the documents: first degree 20-40 points, final grade 10-30 points, up to 20 extra points (5 each: 'good'/'very good' grades in the relevant subject groups; closely related or at least 'good' bachelor thesis; at least one year of qualified related professional experience).
In case of doubt the Examination Board decides (item 8).
German annex: aptitude points ≥ 70 = requirement met; fewer than 70 = not met (no 60–69 band, no conditions).

admission_regulation.version: ZZO: Senat 25.06.2024, Präsidium 26.06.2024, MWK 10.07.2024, Verkündungsblatt Nr. 141/2024 vom 11.07.2024; replaces the ZZO of 10.10.2017 (§ 8). accepted_degree_fields.note: ZZO 2024 § 2 Abs. 1: a degree from Emden/Leer in Elektrotechnik (incl. Praxisverbund), Informatik (incl. Praxisverbund), Sustainable Energy Systems or Maschinenbau und Design (incl. Praxisverbund), or a bachelor 'in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studium' from a Bologna country, or 'an einer anderen ausländischen Hochschule einen gleichwertigen Abschluss in einem fachlich geeigneten vorangegangenen Studium' (equivalence per anabin/ZAB). subject_credit_requirements.note: ZZO 2024 § 2 states no subject credit requirement — only a 'fachlich geeignetes' previous study, decided by the Auswahlkommission. Re-verified 21.10.2026 (AO text re-read): degree fields, 180 CP, grade 2,3 (or average on ≥ 140 CP), written aptitude test passed with ≥ 50 %, English C1 (exempt if entrance qualification or last degree in English), deadlines 15 October (summer) / 15 July (advanced), ranking by grade + specialisation grade — all match.

accepted_degree_fields.note: AO § 1(1)a: first professional degree in Elektrotechnik (Electrical Engineering) or Kommunikationstechnik (Communications Engineering) 'oder in einem Studiengang, der keine wesentlichen Unterschiede in Inhalt, Umfang und Anforderungen zu jenen erkennen lässt', with at least 180 CP. The Auswahlkommission decides on recognition.

grade_requirement.note: AO § 1(1)b: 'Eine Mindestnote von 2,3 als Gesamtnote des vorangegangenen Abschlusses bzw. des zum Zeitpunkt der Bewerbung erreichten Notendurchschnitts bei mindestens 140 CP.' No conversion formula stated.

subject_credit_requirements.note: No subject credit numbers: only the accepted degree fields or a degree without essential differences (exam board check). Owner rule: degree-equivalence only → no subject items. Subject knowledge is tested in the written aptitude test (selection notes).

conditional_admission.mechanism: No rule for making up missing subjects; AO § 1(3) only allows applying with at least 140 CP before the degree is finished (provisional admission).

descriptive_notes: AO § 1(1)c: written aptitude test on fundamentals of electrical engineering and communications engineering ('Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik und Kommunikationstechnik'); 'Der Test gilt als bestanden, wenn mindestens 50 % der verlangten Leistungen erbracht wurden.' Details on the programme website.

If oversubscribed (§ 4): ranking by the average of (a) the degree grade (or average at application with at least 140 CP) and (b) a grade (1.0-5.0) for relevant focus areas of prior study; relevant work or other experience can improve (b) by 0.5, not better than 1.0; ties by lot.
Up to 5 % of places for hardship cases (§ 31 Studienplatzvergabeverordnung).

allowed_exemptions: higher_education_entrance_qualification_or_last_degree_in_english
language_english.note: AO § 1(1)d: 'Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache, die mindestens dem Niveau C1 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) entsprechen'; no proof needed if the university entrance qualification or the last degree was obtained in English. No test scores in the AO. Master application page: language certificates must generally be proven no later than two weeks after the course starts. No IELTS/TOEFL minimum published (AO-MA-CIT 08.04.2026: C1; also met by entrance qualification or last degree in English).

other_requirements: Written aptitude test (pass = at least 50 %)
Provisional admission with at least 140 CP; degree and language proof two weeks after lectures begin, final certificates by 30 June (AO § 1(3))
Direct application to the University of Bremen (no uni-assist for master's; application free of charge)

non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 October (AO § 3; programme page). Advanced students (Fortgeschrittene) can also enter in winter (deadline 15 July).

admission_regulation.title: Aufnahmeordnung für den Masterstudiengang „Space Sciences and Technologies – Sensing, Processing, Communication“ an der Universität Bremen
admission_regulation.version: vom 13. Dezember 2023 (read 21.10.2026). Older AO (ab SoSe 2023) superseded. Re-checked 21.10.2026: no newer AO found (web search); DAAD listing matches degree fields, 180 CP and the 90 physics / 65 EE + 16 maths alternatives.

accepted_degree_fields.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1: first degree in 'Elektrotechnik, Physik, Systems-Engineering, Technomathematik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen Elektrotechnik' or a related degree without substantial differences, 'mit Studienleistungen im Umfang von mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten'. Two subject alternatives: 'mindestens 90 CP im Bereich der Physik' OR 'mindestens 81 CP, die sich zusammensetzen aus 65 CP im Bereich Elektrotechnik und 16 CP im Bereich Mathematik'. This EEE record stores the EE alternative (GPU-R domain policy); the physics alternative (90 CP physics) is for physics graduates.

grade_requirement.note: AO sets no minimum grade; the grade only gives ranking points if admission is restricted (§ 4 Abs. 3: 1,0–1,5 = 80 … 3,6–4,0 = 10).

items.raw_label: AO § 1 Abs. 1: '65 CP im Bereich Elektrotechnik'
AO § 1 Abs. 1: '16 CP im Bereich Mathematik'

subject_credit_requirements.note: EE alternative of AO § 1 Abs. 1 (81 CP = 65 EE + 16 maths). 'Bereich Elektrotechnik' = the whole EE field → general_ee (counts ALL EE subjects, Koushik rule 20.10.2026). Physics alternative (90 CP physics) not stored in this EEE record.

conditional_admission.mechanism: AO § 1 Abs. 3 only allows applying before the degree is finished (at least 130 CP) with admission under the condition that degree and language proof follow 'spätestens zwei Wochen nach Lehrveranstaltungsbeginn' (certificates by 31 December) — a degree-completion rule, not a subject condition.

descriptive_notes: If oversubscribed, ranking by points (AO § 4 Abs. 3, max. 100): grade up to 80 (1,0–1,5 = 80; 1,6–2,0 = 70; 2,1–2,5 = 50; 2,6–3,0 = 40; 3,1–3,5 = 20; 3,6–4,0 = 10) and motivation letter up to 20 (20 / 15 / 5).
Motivation letter explaining the specific interest in Space ST (AO § 1 Abs. 1).
5 % hardship quota (§ 4 Abs. 5).
DAAD listing: winter intake only; application period for beginners 1 March – 30 April; advanced students 1 December – 15 January. No German required.

allowed_exemptions: Hochschulzugangsberechtigung or last university degree obtained in English (AO § 1 Abs. 1)
language_english.note: AO § 1 Abs. 1: English 'mindestens dem Niveau C1' (CEFR); no test scores stated in the AO or on the programme page. Proof also met if the university entrance qualification or the last degree was obtained in English — an Indian degree taught in English may qualify (exam board decides). DAAD International Programmes 2026/2027 (data supplied by the university, read 21.10.2026): 'C1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 7' — IELTS 7.0 stored as the stated example; no TOEFL value given (old record's TOEFL 95 not confirmed).

other_requirements: Motivation letter (AO § 1 Abs. 1)
Online application (programme page); AO available only in German

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 30 April (AO § 3, Ausschlussfrist)
non_eu_deadlines.summer: 15 January — advanced students only (AO § 3)

admission_regulation.title: Studiengangsspezifische Prüfungs- und Studienordnung für den Masterstudiengang Electrical Engineering der Universität Rostock (§ 2)
admission_regulation.version: vom 5. April 2018 i.d.F. der 1. Änderung (2022) und 2. Änderung (15.02.2024); nicht amtliche konsolidierte Lesefassung, for students first enrolled from SS 2024 (read 21.10.2026)

accepted_degree_fields.note: SPSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 2: 'erster berufsqualifizierender Abschluss in einem Studium der Elektrotechnik mit mindestens 180 Leistungspunkten oder ein anderer gleichwertiger Abschluss'. ROUTE A (this record): grade route — degree with at least 85 % of the CGPA. ROUTE B (4594_B): GATE ≥ 500 instead of the grade (§ 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 2). The programme is shown once with the student's best route. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy).

grade_requirement.note: SPSO § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 2: success presumed not to be expected if the degree is 'nicht mindestens 85% des CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) oder bei einem anderen Notensystem mit einer vergleichbaren Note' — unless GATE ≥ 500 (route 4594_B). GPU-R conversion (same as approved Rostock CSI, Koushik decision 19.10.2026): 85 % of the Indian 10-point scale = CGPA 8,5 → 1 + 3 × (10 − 8,5)/5 = 1,9. The old record's 1.8 was not found in the regulation.

items.raw_label: SPSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'Elektromagnetische Felder und Wellen (mindestens drei Leistungspunkte)'
SPSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'Mathematik (mindestens 18 Leistungspunkte)'
SPSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'Programmierung/praktische Informatik (mindestens sechs Leistungspunkte)'

subject_credit_requirements.note: SPSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 3: 'vertiefte Kenntnisse' in the three areas with LP minimums. electromagnetic_field_theory = TAXONOMY GAP (counts 0 until the taxonomy phase). CONFLICT (checked 21.10.2026): the DAAD International Programmes listing still states 'at least 24 credit points in mathematics and at least six credit points in theoretical electrical engineering', 85 % CGPA without the GATE alternative — older values; the SPSO 2024 (and the faculty admission page) state maths 18, EM fields 3, programming 6 and the GATE ≥ 500 alternative. Regulation stored.

conditional_admission.mechanism: SPSO § 2 Abs. 2: the board may invite to a 'klärendes Gespräch'; 'Zulassung unter Vorbehalt' only 'im Falle einer Zulassungsbeschränkung unter Beachtung von § 4 Hochschulzulassungsgesetz'. No rule allowing missing subject LP to be made up (Auflagen) with a cap → false (owner rule).

descriptive_notes: SPSO § 2 Abs. 2: access can only be refused if success is not to be expected; presumed if a criterion of Abs. 1 Nr. 1–3 is not met or the degree is below 85 % of the CGPA (unless GATE ≥ 500), and no further evidence gives a positive overall prognosis.
The examination board may invite the applicant to a clarifying interview (§ 2 Abs. 2).

allowed_exemptions: native English speakers (programme page)
language_english.note: SPSO § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1: 'TOEFL IBT mit mindestens 94 Punkten oder einen IELTS mit mindestens 7,0 Punkten, welcher nicht älter ist als zwei Jahre'. CONFLICT: the admission page's language section says TOEFL > 90 / IELTS 6.5 — higher scores (regulation) stored (Koushik rule: take the higher English score).

other_requirements: Application via uni-assist only; 'You can only apply with your final transcript and degree' (admission page)
German language modules (12 LP, A1–B1) are part of the curriculum for students without German B2 (SPSO § 4 Abs. 8, Anlage 1) — not an admission requirement
Specialisations: Information Technology or Power Engineering

admission_regulation.title: Fachprüfungsordnung (FPO-M) für das Fach Elektrotechnik (ET) im Masterstudium an der Universität Siegen, Artikel 2 § 4 Besondere Zugangsvoraussetzungen
admission_regulation.version: vom 5. Juli 2023 (Amtliche Mitteilungen 40/2023), read 21.10.2026. A 'Lesefassung Juni 2025' is referenced on the department site but its link redirects (not read) — later amendments not checked.

accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 1: Bachelor in Elektrotechnik (or the dual EE programme at Siegen) or a comparable Bachelor; Abs. 2: comparable Bachelors need the minimum LP per area. ROUTE A (this record): variant Communications Technology (20 LP in the variant's topics, English B2). Other English variant: 7927_B. The German-taught variant Automatisierungstechnik is not stored (EEE international focus; GPU-R policy). GPU-R applies the Abs. 2 table to all applicants (strictest reading, as for Siegen mechatronics).

grade_requirement.note: FPO-M § 4 sets no minimum grade.

items.raw_label: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 2: Mathematische Grundlagen 20 LP
FPO-M § 4 Abs. 2: Naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen 15 LP
FPO-M § 4 Abs. 2: Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik und Messtechnik 20 LP
FPO-M § 4 Abs. 2: Theoretische Elektrotechnik (Feldtheorie, Signal- und Systemtheorie) 10 LP

FPO-M § 4 Abs. 1: at least 20 LP in the topics of the variant Communications Technology (Nachrichtentechnik, optische Nachrichtentechnik, Hochfrequenztechnik, elektromagnetische Feldtheorie, Signal- und Systemtheorie)

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPO-M § 4 Abs. 2 minimum LP for comparable Bachelors: Mathematik 20, Naturwissenschaften 15, Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik und Messtechnik 20, Theoretische Elektrotechnik 10, Projektarbeit incl. Bachelorarbeit 10 — the project/thesis item is NOT stored (Koushik rule 19.10.2026: thesis items removed). § 4 Abs. 1: at least 20 LP in the variant's topics. Categories (add-up rule; GPU-R mapping): EE basics + measurement = circuit_theory + electromagnetic_field_theory + measurement_instrumentation (not general_ee, which counts ALL EE subjects); natural sciences = physics + chemistry. Overlap between items allowed (D13 removed). TAXONOMY GAPS: circuit_theory, electromagnetic_field_theory, measurement_instrumentation, signals_systems, microelectronics_semiconductors, electronics, power_electronics, chemistry.

conditional_admission.mechanism: FPO-M § 4: if the minimum LP of Abs. 1 or Abs. 2 are not met, admission is 'nur unter entsprechenden Auflagen gemäß § 4 Absatz 4 RPO-M und/oder nur für bestimmte Studiengangsvarianten möglich' — programme-level rule, no numeric cap (owner rule: true, cap null).

descriptive_notes: ROUTE A – Communications Technology specialisation. Siegen's English-taught EE master has two specialisations with the same general requirements (maths 20, natural sciences 15, EE basics + measurement 20, theoretical EE 10 LP; English B2 / TOEFL 87 / IELTS 6.0; no grade limit). They differ only in the 20 LP specialisation requirement: Route A needs 20 LP in communications engineering, optical communications, high-frequency engineering, electromagnetic field theory or signals & systems (suits communications-focused ECE/EE students). Route B (7927_B, Electronics Design and Technology) needs 20 LP in semiconductor and circuit technology, semiconductor physics, power electronics or high-frequency engineering. The programme is shown once, with the student's best-fitting route; the student chooses one specialisation.
Admission not restricted (programme page).
In special cases the examination board decides individually (programme page).
Enrolment is refused if a required examination in a closely related programme was finally failed (FPO-M § 4 Abs. 5).
DAAD/myGuide listing: winter intake only, 4 semesters; the subject minimums (20/15/20/10 CP + 20 CP in the specialisation) match the FPO.

language_english.note: FPO-M § 4: for Communications Technology and Electronics Design and Technology English 'B2 gemäß des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GeR)' or TOEFL iBT ≥ 87 or IELTS ≥ 6.0; without proof only the German-taught Automatisierungstechnik variant can be studied. CONFLICT (checked 21.10.2026): the DAAD/myGuide listing names lower minimums (TOEFL iBT 72, IELTS 6) — the FPO values (TOEFL iBT 87, IELTS 6.0) are stored (regulation, and Koushik rule: take the higher score).

other_requirements: Application required (online, programme page)

non_eu_deadlines.winter: 30 April (DAAD/myGuide listing, data supplied by the university: '30 April for the next winter semester'; no separate international deadline)

admission_regulation.version: vom 05.07.2023, Mitteilungsblatt Nr. 18/2023 vom 21.09.2023 (text supplied by Koushik 21.10.2026). 1. accepted_degree_fields.note: FPO § 6 Abs. 1 a): Bachelor or Diplom I in Elektrotechnik at Kassel 'oder einen fachlich gleichwertigen Abschluss in Elektrotechnik einer anderen Hochschule mit einer Regelstudienzeit von mindestens sechs Semestern und 180 Credits'. Programme page: 'Electrical Engineering, Communications or a related area'. primary_fields = GPU-R domain (GPU-R policy).

grade_requirement.note: FPO § 6 Abs. 1 b): 'mindestens die Note „gut“' — 'gut' = up to 2,5 on the German scale. No conversion method stated. § 6 Abs. 4: in justified exceptional cases the examination board may decide differently (student note).

subject_credit_requirements.note: FPO § 6 Abs. 2 names four knowledge areas without credit numbers → presence-only items (owner rule). Mapping GPU-R policy (not regulation wording): theoretische Elektrotechnik = electromagnetic_field_theory + signals_systems (add-up); Netzwerktheorie = circuit network theory → circuit_theory. TAXONOMY GAPS: electromagnetic_field_theory, signals_systems, circuit_theory. Presence checks kept: unlike 'sollte' wording (e.g. TU Ilmenau), FPO § 6 Abs. 2 says these knowledge areas 'sind … erforderlich' (are required).

conditional_admission.mechanism: FPO § 6 has no Auflagen rule; § 6 Abs. 4 only lets the examination board deviate from the grade and knowledge requirements 'in begründeten Ausnahmefällen' — an individual exception, not conditional admission.

descriptive_notes: The examination board checks subject equivalence of the degree (FPO § 6 Abs. 1 a) and may make exceptions in justified cases (§ 6 Abs. 4).
Compulsory module 'Social Communication' (6 credits) teaches German-language intercultural skills; students who already have this content take 6 extra elective credits (FPO § 8 Abs. 2).

first degree taught in English (FPO § 6 Abs. 3)
